items: Passport or identity card.
Codice fiscale.

Document that proves why you can register: permit, work contract, UNILAV, family document, or enrollment proof.
Any old Tessera Sanitaria, ASL receipt, rejection letter, or protocol number.

en: Passport or identity card.

it: Passaporto o carta di identita.
Codice fiscale.
Prova dell'indirizzo a Torino: residenza, contratto di affitto, dichiarazione di ospitalita o altro documento dell'indirizzo.
Documento che prova il diritto all'iscrizione: permesso, contratto di lavoro, UNILAV, documento familiare o prova di iscrizione.
Eventuale vecchia Tessera Sanitaria, ricevuta ASL, rifiuto scritto o numero di protocollo.

items: Check first if your case is ordinary SSN registration or a foreigner/student/temporary route.
If your documents are straightforward, verify whether the regional service can handle it online.
If the case is foreign, document-heavy, or already refused, go to the ASL administrative counter for your district.
Ask for SSN registration first. Only after that choose your family doctor or pediatrician.

en: Check first if your case is ordinary SSN registration or a foreigner/student/temporary route.
If your documents are straightforward, verify whether the regional service can handle it online.
If the case is foreign, document-heavy, or already refused, go to the ASL administrative counter for your district.
Ask for SSN registration first. Only after that choose your family doctor or pediatrician.
it: Controlla prima se il tuo caso e un'iscrizione SSN ordinaria oppure un percorso stranieri/studenti/temporaneo.
Se i documenti sono semplici, verifica se il servizio regionale lo gestisce online.
Se il caso riguarda stranieri, molti documenti o un rifiuto gia ricevuto, vai allo sportello amministrativo ASL del tuo distretto.
Chiedi prima l'iscrizione al SSN. Solo dopo scegli medico di base o pediatra.

body.en: Ordinary SSN registration itself is not a separate service fee. The real cost depends on your legal status only if the law puts you in a voluntary registration route.
body.it: L'iscrizione ordinaria al SSN non ha un costo di servizio separato. Il costo reale dipende dal tuo status solo se la legge ti mette nell'iscrizione volontaria.
body.fr: Ordinary SSN registration itself is not a separate service fee. The real cost depends on your legal status only if the law puts you in a voluntary registration route.

body.ar: Ordinary SSN registration itself is not a separate service fee. The real cost depends on your legal status only if the law puts you in a voluntary registration route.

body.en: Ask for the exact reason in writing, the missing document list, and the office protocol number. If the refusal is generic, write to URP or PEC and attach your documents plus the refusal note.
body.it: Chiedi il motivo preciso per iscritto, l'elenco dei documenti mancanti e il numero di protocollo dell'ufficio. Se il rifiuto e generico, scrivi a URP o PEC allegando documenti e nota di rifiuto.

items: Deposito cauzionale: the money held as security, not an extra monthly rent.
Cedolare secca: tax regime chosen by the landlord, not a reason to skip registration.
Spese condominiali: separate building expenses, often partly recoverable from the tenant.
Subentro / cessione: change of people on the contract, not an informal roommate swap.
Transitorio: a contract that needs a real temporary reason.

en: Deposito cauzionale: the money held as security, not an extra monthly rent.
Cedolare secca: tax regime chosen by the landlord, not a reason to skip registration.
Spese condominiali: separate building expenses, often partly recoverable from the tenant.
Subentro / cessione: change of people on the contract, not an informal roommate swap.
Transitorio: a contract that needs a real temporary reason.
it: Deposito cauzionale: somma trattenuta come garanzia, non affitto extra mensile.
Cedolare secca: regime fiscale scelto dal proprietario, non motivo per saltare la registrazione.
Spese condominiali: spese del palazzo separate, spesso in parte ribaltate sull'inquilino.
Subentro / cessione: cambio delle persone nel contratto, non semplice scambio informale di coinquilino.
Transitorio: contratto che ha bisogno di una vera ragione temporanea.

it: Se sei extra-UE: controlla prima visto, scadenza kit permesso e percorso Questura/Poste.
Ottieni o verifica il codice fiscale perché quasi tutti gli altri uffici lo chiedono.
Metti in ordine la prova dell’alloggio: contratto, ospitalità o prova di residenza/domicilio.

items: Codice fiscale: tax identification code used almost everywhere.

CIE: electronic identity card; can also be used for online login with CieID.
CNS / health card: smart-card access method if activated with PIN.
PEC: certified email with legal proof when sent to another PEC.
Protocol number: official tracking number for a request submitted to an office.
Receipt / ricevuta: proof that a request, kit, PEC, or online form was submitted.

it: Codice fiscale: codice identificativo fiscale usato quasi ovunque.
SPID: identità digitale per accedere a molti servizi online pubblici e privati.
CIE: carta d’identità elettronica; può servire anche per accesso online con CieID.
CNS / tessera sanitaria: metodo di accesso con smart card se attivato con PIN.
PEC: email certificata con prova legale quando inviata a un’altra PEC.
Numero di protocollo: numero ufficiale per seguire una richiesta inviata a un ufficio.
Ricevuta: prova che una richiesta, kit, PEC o modulo online è stato inviato.

items: Get codice fiscale first.
Get or request CIE if you are resident or eligible.
Activate SPID when you have a valid Italian identity document and tax-code document.
Activate CIE online login with CieID if you have CIE and PIN/PUK.
Get PEC when you need formal requests or deadline-sensitive communication.
Keep protocol numbers and receipts in one folder.

it: Ottieni prima il codice fiscale.
Richiedi la CIE se sei residente o hai i requisiti.
Attiva SPID quando hai documento italiano valido e documento codice fiscale.
Attiva accesso CIE online con CieID se hai CIE e PIN/PUK.
Attiva PEC quando ti servono richieste formali o comunicazioni con scadenza.
Conserva protocolli e ricevute in una sola cartella.

body.en: INPS says the application must be sent within 68 days from the end of the employment relationship and only after the work relationship has ended. If you apply within the first eight days, NASpI can start from the eighth day after the end of work; otherwise it normally starts from the day after the application.

Se invii entro i primi otto giorni, la NASpI può decorrere dall’ottavo giorno dopo la cessazione; altrimenti di solito decorre dal giorno successivo alla domanda.

items: You work like an employee but they ask you to open partita IVA.

You cannot freely organize time, price, method, or place of work.

items: Only one client.
Fixed working hours decided by the client.
Client controls how and where you work.
You cannot choose prices or negotiate real conditions.
You work inside the company like employees.
You use company tools and follow company managers daily.
You need permission for holidays or absences.
You have no paid holidays, sick leave, or unemployment protection.
They promise a net amount but ignore taxes and contributions.
They tell you partita IVA is mandatory but the work looks like employee work.

Non hai ferie pagate, malattia o protezione disoccupazione.
Promettono un netto ma ignorano tasse e contributi.
Dicono che la partita IVA è obbligatoria ma il lavoro sembra dipendente.

items: Non-EU with type D study visa: prepare residence permit application quickly after arrival.
EU staying 3–12 months: check temporary population registration rules.
Get or verify codice fiscale before bank, rent, ASL, phone, and university paperwork.

it: Extra-UE con visto studio D: prepara rapidamente la domanda di permesso dopo l’arrivo.
UE che resta 3–12 mesi: controlla le regole della popolazione temporanea.
Ottieni o verifica il codice fiscale prima di banca, affitto, ASL, telefono e pratiche universitarie.
Organizza assicurazione sanitaria o iscrizione SSN prima delle scadenze del permesso.
Tieni forte la prova alloggio per EDISU, Questura, ASL, Comune e ISEE.
Attiva SPID/CIE/PEC appena possibile.
Usa ticket e portali ufficiali, non email casuali, quando l’universita lo richiede.

items: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.

en: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.
it: Studenti UE che restano 3–12 mesi possono dover fare iscrizione nella popolazione temporanea, non un permesso.
Studenti extra-UE fino a 90 giorni possono dover fare dichiarazione di presenza secondo ingresso e alloggio.
Studenti in mobilita con permesso di altro Paese UE possono essere esenti dal permesso italiano solo se tutte le condizioni sono rispettate.
Se salti l’appuntamento in Questura, la pratica puo essere sospesa.
Se il primo soggiorno supera un anno, potrebbe servire firmare l’Accordo di Integrazione.

items: You and your family income/assets are in Italy: ordinary ISEE may be enough.
Your family income/assets are abroad: ISEE Parificato is commonly required.
You are independent from family: check the university/EDISU rules very carefully before assuming this.
You apply for EDISU scholarship: follow the current EDISU call.
You only need tuition reduction: follow your university fee rules.
If documents are foreign, check translation, legalization, apostille, and country-specific rules before paying.

You only need tuition reduction: follow your university fee rules.
If documents are foreign, check translation, legalization, apostille, and country-specific rules before paying.
it: Tu e redditi/patrimoni familiari siete in Italia: l’ISEE ordinario puo bastare.
Redditi/patrimoni familiari sono all’estero: spesso serve ISEE Parificato.
Ti consideri indipendente dalla famiglia: controlla bene regole universita/EDISU prima di darlo per scontato.
Fai domanda borsa EDISU: segui il bando EDISU attuale.
Ti serve solo riduzione tasse: segui le regole tasse del tuo ateneo.
Se i documenti sono esteri, controlla traduzione, legalizzazione, apostille e regole per Paese prima di pagare.

items: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.

en: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.
it: Primo rinnovo: almeno un esame superato.
Rinnovi successivi: almeno due esami per anno accademico.
Chiedi all’ufficio universitario se il tuo caso e speciale, per esempio dottorato, mobilita, anno solo tesi o corso senza esami ordinari.
La Questura puo chiedere documenti aggiuntivi in casi individuali.

items: Certificate of enrolment for the current academic year.
Certificate with exams passed and dates/credits if available.
Certificate in Italian if Questura requires Italian.
Stamp duty if the university requires it for official certificates.
Printed certificate if online certificate is not accepted for your case.
Clarification from student office if your exams are not visible yet.

Certificato con esami superati e date/crediti se disponibile.
Certificato in italiano se la Questura lo richiede.
Marca da bollo se l’universita la richiede per certificati ufficiali.
Certificato stampato se quello online non e accettato nel tuo caso.

items: Check the exact certificate requested by Questura or the university immigration page.
Download it from the student portal if available.
If not available, open a ticket to the student office.
Mention that it is for residence permit renewal.
Ask whether it must show exams, credits, and academic year.
Save the certificate as PDF and print a copy for the kit or Questura appointment.
If an exam is missing from the certificate, attach proof or ask office to update the record.

it: Controlla il certificato esatto richiesto da Questura o pagina immigrazione universitaria.
Scaricalo dal portale studenti se disponibile.
Se non disponibile, apri ticket alla segreteria.
Scrivi che serve per rinnovo permesso di soggiorno.
Chiedi se deve mostrare esami, crediti e anno accademico.
Salva il certificato in PDF e stampa una copia per kit o appuntamento Questura.
Se manca un esame dal certificato, allega prova o chiedi aggiornamento carriera.

items: Private insurance: may be enough for permesso, but check coverage limits and reimbursement rules.

STP/ENI: solo per casi speciali senza accesso ordinario SSN, non come normale assicurazione studenti.

items: Ask: who issued the document or bill?
Ask: who rejected the request?
Ask: who can change the official record?
Ask: is this a public-office issue, contract issue, payment issue, or legal dispute?
If there is a protocol number, start from the office that issued it.
If money was charged by a company, start from that company’s complaint channel.
If there is a deadline or legal paper, do not wait for informal replies.
If unsure, send a short information request before sending a full formal complaint.

it: Chiediti: chi ha emesso il documento o la bolletta?

Chiediti: è un problema di ufficio pubblico, contratto, pagamento o vertenza legale?
Se c’è un protocollo, parti dall’ufficio che lo ha emesso.
Se il costo è stato addebitato da un’azienda, parti dal canale reclami dell’azienda.
Se c’è una scadenza o un atto legale, non aspettare risposte informali.
Se hai dubbi, invia una richiesta breve di informazioni prima del reclamo completo.

body.en: PEC can prove sending, delivery, date, and message integrity when sent correctly from PEC to PEC. It has legal value similar to registered mail with return receipt, but it does not make an incomplete request valid.
body.it: La PEC può provare invio, consegna, data e integrità del messaggio quando inviata correttamente da PEC a PEC. Ha valore simile a una raccomandata A/R, ma non rende valida una richiesta incompleta.

body.ar: PEC can prove sending, delivery, date, and message integrity when sent correctly from PEC to PEC. It has legal value similar to registered mail with return receipt, but it does not make an incomplete request valid.

items: Low ISEE + bills: check bonus sociale for electricity, gas, water, and waste.
Children: check Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido, Bonus nuovi nati, and school benefits.
Rent difficulty: check Regione/Comune rent support and emergency housing paths.
University student: check EDISU, tuition reduction, ISEE/ISEE Parificato, and rental proof.
School-age child in Piemonte: check Voucher scuola Piemonte.
Disability or serious health condition: check ADI, disability-linked INPS benefits, bonus sociale disagio fisico, and local support.
Unemployed or fragile household: check NASpI, ADI, SFL, Comune social services, and patronato.
Psychological support: check Bonus psicologo only when the INPS application window is open.
Automatic benefits: check that ISEE, household, IBAN, and contract-holder data are correct.

Bonus automatici: controlla che ISEE, nucleo, IBAN e intestatario contratto siano corretti.

items: Likely relevant: conditions look close, verify the official page.
Maybe relevant: one or more key details are missing.
Not for you: the benefit is for a different group.
Automatic: no normal application, but data must be correct.
Seasonal: exists, but the application window may be closed.
Local: depends on Regione or Comune, not only national rules.
Needs CAF or patronato: do not try alone if documents are complex.
Needs official confirmation: rules changed recently or the case is unusual.

it: Probabilmente rilevante: le condizioni sembrano vicine, verifica la pagina ufficiale.
Forse rilevante: mancano uno o più dettagli importanti.
Non adatto: il beneficio è per un altro gruppo.
Automatico: non c’è domanda normale, ma i dati devono essere corretti.
Stagionale: esiste, ma la finestra domanda può essere chiusa.
Locale: dipende da Regione o Comune, non solo da regole nazionali.
Serve CAF o patronato: meglio non fare da solo se i documenti sono complessi.
Serve conferma ufficiale: regole cambiate da poco o caso particolare.

items: Ordinary ISEE: general benefits and many local supports.
ISEE Minorenni: often needed when benefits are for a minor child, especially when parents are not married/not living together.
ISEE Universitario: university fees and student benefits for Italian-based households.
ISEE Parificato: often used by foreign students with family income/assets abroad.
Current ISEE: used when income, work, or household situation changed significantly.
2026 ISEE for family and inclusion benefits: used for ADI, SFL, Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido, and Bonus nuovi nati.

it: ISEE ordinario: benefici generali e molti sostegni locali.
ISEE minorenni: spesso necessario per benefici rivolti a figli minorenni, soprattutto con genitori non coniugati/non conviventi.
ISEE universitario: tasse universitarie e benefici studenti per nuclei in Italia.
ISEE parificato: spesso usato da studenti stranieri con redditi/patrimoni familiari all’estero.
ISEE corrente: usato quando reddito, lavoro o nucleo sono cambiati molto.
ISEE 2026 per prestazioni familiari e inclusione: usato per ADI, SFL, Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido e Bonus nuovi nati.

items: Submit DSU and get a valid ISEE.
Make sure the bill is in the name of someone in the ISEE household.
Make sure the supply is domestic/residential when required.
The discount is normally applied automatically if the data matches.
If the bill is in the landlord’s name, the direct bonus may not appear.
Check later bills and ask supplier/CAF/Sportello if the discount is missing.
Keep ISEE receipt and bills.

it: Presenta DSU e ottieni ISEE valido.
Assicurati che la bolletta sia intestata a un componente del nucleo ISEE.
Assicurati che la fornitura sia domestica/residenziale quando richiesto.
Lo sconto di solito viene applicato automaticamente se i dati coincidono.
Se la bolletta è intestata al proprietario, il bonus diretto potrebbe non comparire.
Controlla le bollette successive e chiedi a fornitore/CAF/Sportello se lo sconto manca.
Conserva ricevuta ISEE e bollette.

body.en: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.it: Un contributo, un prestito, una garanzia pubblica e una sospensione rate risolvono problemi diversi. Se li confondi, puoi firmare un debito quando ti serviva un beneficio, oppure aspettarti soldi gratuiti da qualcosa che va restituito.
body.fr: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.es: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.fa: Un contributo, un prestito, una garanzia pubblica e una sospensione rate risolvono problemi diversi. Se li confondi, puoi firmare un debito quando ti serviva un beneficio, oppure aspettarti soldi gratuiti da qualcosa che va restituito.
body.ar: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.

items: Grant or bonus: money/support you usually do not repay, if you meet the rules.
Loan: money you borrow and must repay, usually with interest and fees.
Credit line: money you can use up to a limit, then repay later.
Public guarantee: the State helps the bank reduce risk, but you still owe the bank.
Mortgage suspension: temporary pause in payments, not cancellation of the debt.
Personal loan: credit for personal needs, with instalments and total cost.
Student honor loan: usually a credit line during study, then repayment starts later.
Payment plan: divides a debt into instalments; it does not erase the debt.

en: Grant or bonus: money/support you usually do not repay, if you meet the rules.
Loan: money you borrow and must repay, usually with interest and fees.
Credit line: money you can use up to a limit, then repay later.
Public guarantee: the State helps the bank reduce risk, but you still owe the bank.
Mortgage suspension: temporary pause in payments, not cancellation of the debt.
Personal loan: credit for personal needs, with instalments and total cost.
Student honor loan: usually a credit line during study, then repayment starts later.
Payment plan: divides a debt into instalments; it does not erase the debt.
it: Contributo o bonus: soldi/supporto che di solito non devi restituire, se rispetti le regole.
Prestito: soldi che prendi in prestito e devi restituire, spesso con interessi e spese.
Linea di credito: importo che puoi usare entro un limite e rimborsare dopo.
Garanzia pubblica: lo Stato aiuta la banca a ridurre il rischio, ma il debito resta tuo.
Sospensione mutuo: pausa temporanea delle rate, non cancellazione del debito.
Prestito personale: credito per esigenze personali, con rate e costo totale.
Prestito d’onore studenti: spesso linea di credito durante lo studio, poi rimborso successivo.
Piano di rientro: divide un debito in rate; non cancella il debito.

Check whether insurance is optional or required.
Check late-payment consequences.
Check early-repayment rules.
Ask what happens if your income drops.
Do not sign under pressure or during a phone call without written documents.

Chiedi prima l'iscrizione al SSN. Solo dopo scegli medico di base o pediatra.

items: 4+4: standard residential contract if you need ordinary stability.
3+2 agreed-rent: often useful in Torino when the rent follows the local territorial agreement.
Student contract: only if the student conditions are real and documented.
Transitory contract: only if there is a real temporary reason. It is not a shortcut for everything.
Single room or bed: still check whether you are getting a real written contract and proper registration.

en: 4+4: standard residential contract if you need ordinary stability.
3+2 agreed-rent: often useful in Torino when the rent follows the local territorial agreement.
Student contract: only if the student conditions are real and documented.
Transitory contract: only if there is a real temporary reason. It is not a shortcut for everything.
Single room or bed: still check whether you are getting a real written contract and proper registration.
it: 4+4: contratto abitativo ordinario se ti serve stabilita normale.
3+2 a canone concordato: spesso utile a Torino se il canone segue l'accordo territoriale locale.
Contratto studenti: solo se le condizioni studente sono reali e documentabili.
Contratto transitorio: solo se c'e una vera ragione temporanea. Non e una scorciatoia per tutto.
Stanza o posto letto: controlla comunque contratto scritto e registrazione vera.

en: Deposito cauzionale: the money held as security, not an extra monthly rent.
Cedolare secca: tax regime chosen by the landlord, not a reason to skip registration.
Spese condominiali: separate building expenses, often partly recoverable from the tenant.
Subentro / cessione: change of people on the contract, not an informal roommate swap.
Transitorio: a contract that needs a real temporary reason.
it: Deposito cauzionale: somma trattenuta come garanzia, non affitto extra mensile.
Cedolare secca: regime fiscale scelto dal proprietario, non motivo per saltare la registrazione.
Spese condominiali: spese del palazzo separate, spesso in parte ribaltate sull'inquilino.
Subentro / cessione: cambio delle persone nel contratto, non semplice scambio informale di coinquilino.
Transitorio: contratto che ha bisogno di una vera ragione temporanea.

items: Get codice fiscale first.
Get or request CIE if you are resident or eligible.

Get PEC when you need formal requests or deadline-sensitive communication.
Keep protocol numbers and receipts in one folder.

label.en: INPS — how to apply for NASpI
Agenzia Entrate — VAT activity forms AA7/AA9
label.it: Agenzia Entrate — modelli attività IVA AA7/AA9
Agenzia Piemonte Lavoro — Centri per l’Impiego

title.en: I do not know which work or INPS route applies
title.it: Non so quale percorso lavoro o INPS si applica

description.en: Start here if you do not know whether your problem belongs to INPS, patronato, CAF, Centro per l’Impiego, union, employer, or accountant.
description.it: Parti da qui se non sai se il tuo problema riguarda INPS, patronato, CAF, Centro per l’Impiego, sindacato, datore di lavoro o commercialista.
description.fr: Commencez ici si vous ne savez pas si votre problème concerne INPS, patronato, CAF, centre pour l’emploi, syndicat, employeur ou comptable.
description.es: Empieza aquí si no sabes si tu problema corresponde a INPS, patronato, CAF, centro de empleo, sindicato, empleador o contable.
description.fa: اگر نمی‌دانی مشکل تو مربوط به INPS، patronato، CAF، مرکز کار، اتحادیه، کارفرما یا حسابدار است، از اینجا شروع کن.
description.ar: ابدأ هنا إذا لم تعرف هل مشكلتك تخص INPS أو patronato أو CAF أو مركز العمل أو النقابة أو صاحب العمل أو المحاسب.

title.en: I lost my job and need NASpI or unemployment help
title.it: Ho perso il lavoro e mi serve aiuto per NASpI o disoccupazione

description.en: Understand if you can ask for NASpI, what documents to prepare, when to apply, and what to do after the application.
description.it: Capisci se puoi chiedere la NASpI, quali documenti preparare, quando fare domanda e cosa fare dopo l’invio.
description.fr: Comprendre si vous pouvez demander NASpI, quels documents préparer, quand déposer la demande et quoi faire ensuite.
description.es: Entiende si puedes pedir NASpI, qué documentos preparar, cuándo solicitar y qué hacer después.
description.fa: بفهم آیا می‌توانی NASpI بگیری، چه مدارکی لازم است، کی درخواست بدهی و بعدش چه کار کنی.
description.ar: افهم هل يمكنك طلب NASpI وما المستندات المطلوبة ومتى تقدم وماذا تفعل بعد الطلب.

title.en: I need Centro per l'Impiego or DID obligations help
title.it: Mi serve aiuto su Centro per l'Impiego o obblighi DID

description.en: Understand unemployment status, DID, the personalised service agreement, and what to do after NASpI.
description.it: Capisci stato di disoccupazione, DID, patto di servizio personalizzato e cosa fare dopo la NASpI.
description.fr: Comprendre le statut de chômage, la DID, l’accord de service personnalisé et quoi faire après NASpI.
description.es: Entiende estado de desempleo, DID, acuerdo personalizado y qué hacer después de NASpI.
description.fa: وضعیت بیکاری، DID، توافق خدمات شخصی و کارهای بعد از NASpI را بشناس.
description.ar: افهم حالة البطالة وDID واتفاق الخدمة الشخصي وما يجب فعله بعد NASpI.

title.en: I need patronato, CAF, or union support
title.it: Mi serve supporto da patronato, CAF o sindacato

description.en: Understand where to go for INPS applications, ISEE/taxes, unpaid salary, dismissal, and work disputes.
description.it: Capisci dove andare per domande INPS, ISEE/tasse, stipendio non pagato, licenziamento e vertenze di lavoro.
description.fr: Comprendre où aller pour demandes INPS, ISEE/impôts, salaire impayé, licenciement et litiges de travail.
description.es: Entiende dónde ir para solicitudes INPS, ISEE/impuestos, salario impagado, despido y disputas laborales.
description.fa: بفهم برای درخواست INPS، ISEE/مالیات، حقوق پرداخت‌نشده، اخراج و اختلاف کاری کجا بروی.
description.ar: افهم أين تذهب لطلبات INPS وISEE/الضرائب والراتب غير المدفوع والفصل ونزاعات العمل.

title.en: I need documents from the employer
title.it: Mi servono documenti dal datore di lavoro

description.en: Ask for contracts, payslips, termination documents, CU, UNILAV, TFR documents, and written proof from the employer.
description.it: Chiedi contratto, buste paga, documenti di fine rapporto, CU, UNILAV, TFR e prove scritte dal datore.
description.fr: Demandez contrat, fiches de paie, documents de fin de contrat, CU, UNILAV, TFR et preuves écrites.
description.es: Pide contrato, nóminas, documentos de fin de relación, CU, UNILAV, TFR y pruebas escritas.
description.fa: قرارداد، فیش حقوقی، مدارک پایان کار، CU، UNILAV، TFR و مدارک کتبی از کارفرما بخواه.
description.ar: اطلب العقد وكشوف الراتب ووثائق نهاية العمل وCU وUNILAV وTFR والإثباتات المكتوبة.

title.it: Problema di stipendio, busta paga o TFR

description.en: Understand payslips, unpaid salary, missing final payment, TFR, ferie, permessi, and when to contact a union.
description.it: Capisci buste paga, stipendio non pagato, ultimo pagamento mancante, TFR, ferie, permessi e quando contattare un sindacato.
description.fr: Comprendre fiches de paie, salaire impayé, dernier paiement manquant, TFR, congés et quand contacter un syndicat.
description.es: Entiende nóminas, salario impagado, último pago faltante, TFR, vacaciones y cuándo contactar sindicato.
description.fa: فیش حقوقی، حقوق پرداخت‌نشده، پرداخت نهایی، TFR، مرخصی و زمان تماس با اتحادیه را بفهم.
description.ar: افهم كشوف الراتب والراتب غير المدفوع والدفع النهائي وTFR والإجازات ومتى تتصل بالنقابة.

title.en: My INPS request is pending, blocked, or unclear
title.it: La mia pratica INPS e in attesa, bloccata o poco chiara

description.en: Check INPS application status, send missing documents, reply to rejection, and understand when to contact patronato first.
description.it: Controlla stato domanda INPS, invia documenti mancanti, rispondi a rigetti e capisci quando contattare prima il patronato.
description.fr: Vérifier l’état des demandes INPS, envoyer des documents manquants, répondre aux rejets et savoir quand contacter patronato.
description.es: Consulta estado de solicitudes INPS, envía documentos faltantes, responde rechazos y entiende cuándo contactar patronato.
description.fa: وضعیت درخواست INPS را بررسی کن، مدارک ناقص بفرست، به رد شدن پاسخ بده و بدان کی اول با patronato تماس بگیری.
description.ar: تحقق من حالة طلبات INPS وأرسل المستندات الناقصة ورد على الرفض وافهم متى تتصل بـ patronato.

title.en: I need sick-leave or family-benefit help
title.it: Mi serve aiuto su malattia o prestazioni familiari

description.en: Understand sick leave, medical certificates, maternity/paternity, family benefits, and what to ask INPS or patronato.
description.it: Capisci malattia, certificato medico, maternità/paternità, benefici familiari e cosa chiedere a INPS o patronato.
description.fr: Comprendre arrêt maladie, certificats médicaux, maternité/paternité, aides familiales et quoi demander à INPS ou patronato.
description.es: Entiende baja médica, certificados, maternidad/paternidad, beneficios familiares y qué pedir a INPS o patronato.
description.fa: بیماری، گواهی پزشکی، زایمان/پدری، مزایای خانوادگی و سؤال از INPS یا patronato را بشناس.
description.ar: افهم الإجازة المرضية والشهادات الطبية والأمومة/الأبوة والمزايا العائلية وما تسأل INPS أو patronato.

title.en: I need freelance or partita IVA basics
title.it: Mi servono basi pratiche su freelance o partita IVA

description.en: Understand what partita IVA is, who should open it, how it works, what you must pay, and when it may be risky.
description.it: Capisci cos’è la partita IVA, chi dovrebbe aprirla, come funziona, cosa devi pagare e quando può essere rischiosa.
description.fr: Comprendre ce qu’est partita IVA, qui doit l’ouvrir, comment elle fonctionne, quoi payer et quand elle peut être risquée.
description.es: Entiende qué es partita IVA, quién debe abrirla, cómo funciona, qué debes pagar y cuándo puede ser riesgosa.
description.fa: بفهم partita IVA چیست، چه کسی باید آن را باز کند، چطور کار می‌کند، چه باید پرداخت کنی و چه زمانی خطرناک است.
description.ar: افهم ما هي partita IVA ومن يجب أن يفتحها وكيف تعمل وما الذي يجب دفعه ومتى تكون خطرة.

title.en: I need contribution or tax basics
title.it: Mi servono basi pratiche su contributi o tasse

description.en: Understand INPS Gestione Separata, professional funds, forfettario basics, invoices, F24 payments, and what to ask an accountant.
description.it: Capisci Gestione Separata INPS, casse professionali, basi del forfettario, fatture, F24 e cosa chiedere al commercialista.
description.fr: Comprendre Gestione Separata INPS, caisses professionnelles, bases du régime forfaitaire, factures, F24 et questions au comptable.
description.es: Entiende Gestione Separata INPS, fondos profesionales, forfettario, facturas, F24 y qué preguntar al contable.
description.fa: Gestione Separata INPS، صندوق‌های حرفه‌ای، اصول forfettario، فاکتور، F24 و سؤال از حسابدار را بشناس.
description.ar: افهم Gestione Separata INPS والصناديق المهنية ونظام forfettario والفواتير وF24 وما تسأل المحاسب.

body.en: Work problems in Italy split between different offices. If you ask the wrong place, you lose time. INPS handles benefits, but unpaid salary or a bad contract is usually not solved by INPS.

body.en: INPS says the application must be sent within 68 days from the end of the employment relationship and only after the work relationship has ended. If you apply within the first eight days, NASpI can start from the eighth day after the end of work; otherwise it normally starts from the day after the application.
body.it: INPS indica che la domanda deve essere inviata entro 68 giorni dalla cessazione del rapporto e solo dopo la fine del rapporto di lavoro. Se invii entro i primi otto giorni, la NASpI può decorrere dall’ottavo giorno dopo la cessazione; altrimenti di solito decorre dal giorno successivo alla domanda.

items: You issue invoices.

You must keep accounting records or pay an accountant.
You must check whether your residence permit allows self-employment.

it: Emetti fatture.

Paghi tasse e contributi a scadenze.
Può servire Gestione Separata INPS, gestione artigiani/commercianti o cassa professionale.
Devi tenere contabilità o pagare un commercialista.
Devi verificare se il tuo permesso consente lavoro autonomo.

items: You work like an employee but they ask you to open partita IVA.
You have only one client who controls your schedule and work.
You do not know how much taxes and contributions will cost.
You need stable employee rights such as paid holidays, sick leave, and unemployment protection.
You are a non-EU citizen and your permit does not allow that activity.
The client promises a net amount but does not explain taxes and INPS.
You cannot freely organize time, price, method, or place of work.

body.en: For individuals and self-employed workers, partita IVA is opened by filing the correct start-of-activity declaration with Agenzia Entrate. Many people use a commercialista because ATECO code, tax regime, and INPS position must be chosen correctly.

body.en: Sometimes a company asks someone to open partita IVA to avoid hiring them as an employee. If they control your schedule, tools, place of work, and tasks like an employer, the situation can be risky.
body.it: A volte un’azienda chiede di aprire partita IVA per evitare un’assunzione. Se controlla orari, strumenti, luogo e mansioni come un datore di lavoro, la situazione può essere rischiosa.

items: Only one client.

You need permission for holidays or absences.
You have no paid holidays, sick leave, or unemployment protection.
They promise a net amount but ignore taxes and contributions.
They tell you partita IVA is mandatory but the work looks like employee work.

label.en: PoliTO — residence permits and stay requirements
label.it: PoliTO — permessi e requisiti di soggiorno

label.en: UniTo — residence permit and stay requirements
label.it: UniTo — permesso e requisiti di soggiorno

title.en: I just arrived in Torino as a student
title.it: Sono appena arrivato a Torino come studente

description.en: Start here if you study in Torino and do not know whether your problem belongs to PoliTO, UniTo, EDISU, Questura, ASL, CAF, Comune, or your landlord.
description.it: Parti da qui se studi a Torino e non sai se il problema riguarda PoliTO, UniTo, EDISU, Questura, ASL, CAF, Comune o il proprietario di casa.
description.fr: Commencez ici si vous etudiez a Turin et ne savez pas si votre probleme concerne PoliTO, UniTo, EDISU, Questura, ASL, CAF, Comune ou le proprietaire.
description.es: Empieza aqui si estudias en Turin y no sabes si tu problema corresponde a PoliTO, UniTo, EDISU, Questura, ASL, CAF, Comune o el propietario.
description.fa: اگر در تورین درس می‌خوانی و نمی‌دانی مشکل تو مربوط به PoliTO، UniTo، EDISU، Questura، ASL، CAF، Comune یا صاحبخانه است، از اینجا شروع کن.
description.ar: ابدأ هنا إذا كنت تدرس في تورينو ولا تعرف هل مشكلتك تخص PoliTO أو UniTo أو EDISU أو Questura أو ASL أو CAF أو Comune أو المالك.

description.en: Use this if you study at Politecnico di Torino and need help with immigration, tickets, enrolment, fees, career, exams, certificates, or student services.
description.it: Da usare se studi al Politecnico di Torino e ti serve aiuto con immigrazione, ticket, iscrizione, tasse, carriera, esami, certificati o servizi studenti.
description.fr: A utiliser si vous etudiez au Politecnico di Torino et avez besoin d aide pour immigration, tickets, inscription, frais, carriere, examens ou services.
description.es: Usalo si estudias en Politecnico di Torino y necesitas ayuda con inmigracion, tickets, matricula, tasas, carrera, examenes o servicios.
description.fa: اگر در Politecnico di Torino درس می‌خوانی و درباره مهاجرت، تیکت، ثبت‌نام، شهریه، کارنامه، امتحان یا خدمات دانشجویی کمک می‌خواهی، از این استفاده کن.
description.ar: استخدم هذا إذا كنت تدرس في Politecnico di Torino وتحتاج مساعدة في الهجرة أو التذاكر أو التسجيل أو الرسوم أو المسار الأكاديمي أو الخدمات.

description.en: Use this if you study at University of Turin and need help with international documents, student records, tuition, residence permit, mobility, certificates, or support services.
description.it: Da usare se studi all’Universita di Torino e ti serve aiuto con documenti internazionali, segreteria studenti, tasse, permesso, mobilita, certificati o servizi di supporto.
description.fr: A utiliser si vous etudiez a l Universite de Turin et avez besoin d aide pour documents internationaux, dossier etudiant, frais, permis, mobilite ou support.
description.es: Usalo si estudias en la Universidad de Turin y necesitas ayuda con documentos internacionales, expediente, tasas, permiso, movilidad o apoyo.
description.fa: اگر در دانشگاه تورین درس می‌خوانی و برای مدارک بین‌المللی، پرونده دانشجویی، شهریه، اقامت، جابه‌جایی یا خدمات پشتیبانی کمک می‌خواهی، از این استفاده کن.
description.ar: استخدم هذا إذا كنت تدرس في جامعة تورينو وتحتاج مساعدة في الوثائق الدولية أو السجل الطلابي أو الرسوم أو الإقامة أو التنقل أو الدعم.

title.en: I need visa or permesso support as a student
title.it: Mi serve supporto su visto o permesso come studente

description.en: Understand first issue, renewal, work limits, deadlines, and which university office can support your student permit documents.
description.it: Capisci primo rilascio, rinnovo, limiti di lavoro, scadenze e quale ufficio universitario puo supportare i documenti del permesso studenti.
description.fr: Comprendre premiere demande, renouvellement, limites de travail, delais et quel bureau universitaire peut soutenir les documents du permis.
description.es: Entiende primera emision, renovacion, limites de trabajo, plazos y que oficina universitaria puede apoyar tus documentos del permiso.
description.fa: صدور اول، تمدید، محدودیت کار، مهلت‌ها و اینکه کدام دفتر دانشگاه برای مدارک اقامت کمک می‌کند را بفهم.
description.ar: افهم الإصدار الأول والتجديد وحدود العمل والمواعيد وأي مكتب جامعي يدعم وثائق التصريح.

title.en: I need work rules for students
title.it: Mi servono le regole lavoro per studenti

description.en: Understand the 20-hour weekly rule, yearly limit, and the difference between student work, part-time collaborations, and normal employment.
description.it: Capisci la regola delle 20 ore, il limite annuo e la differenza tra lavoro studente, collaborazioni part-time e lavoro normale.
description.fr: Comprendre la regle des 20 heures, la limite annuelle et la difference entre travail etudiant, collaborations part-time et emploi normal.
description.es: Entiende la regla de 20 horas, el limite anual y la diferencia entre trabajo estudiante, colaboraciones part-time y empleo normal.
description.fa: قانون ۲۰ ساعت هفتگی، سقف سالانه و تفاوت کار دانشجویی، همکاری پاره‌وقت و کار عادی را بفهم.
description.ar: افهم قاعدة 20 ساعة أسبوعياً والحد السنوي والفرق بين عمل الطالب والتعاون الجزئي والعمل العادي.

title.en: I need EDISU scholarship or housing help
title.it: Mi serve aiuto EDISU per borsa o alloggio

description.en: Understand scholarships, student housing, canteens, grants, documents, yearly calls, and how to use EDISU ticketing.
description.it: Capisci borse di studio, residenze, mense, contributi, documenti, bandi annuali e come usare il ticketing EDISU.
description.fr: Comprendre bourses, residences, cantines, aides, documents, appels annuels et le ticketing EDISU.
description.es: Entiende becas, residencias, comedores, ayudas, documentos, convocatorias anuales y el ticketing EDISU.
description.fa: بورسیه‌ها، خوابگاه، سلف، کمک‌هزینه‌ها، مدارک، فراخوان‌های سالانه و تیکتینگ EDISU را بشناس.
description.ar: افهم المنح والسكن الطلابي والمطاعم والمساعدات والوثائق والإعلانات السنوية وتذاكر EDISU.

title.en: I need tuition, ISEE, or fee-reduction help
title.it: Mi serve aiuto su tasse, ISEE o riduzione contributi

description.en: Understand fee reduction, Italian ISEE, ISEE Parificato for foreign income, sanctions, deadlines, and where to ask for help.
description.it: Capisci riduzione tasse, ISEE italiano, ISEE Parificato per redditi esteri, controlli, scadenze e dove chiedere aiuto.
description.fr: Comprendre reduction des frais, ISEE italien, ISEE Parificato pour revenus etrangers, controles, delais et aide.
description.es: Entiende reduccion de tasas, ISEE italiano, ISEE Parificato para ingresos extranjeros, controles, plazos y ayuda.
description.fa: کاهش شهریه، ISEE ایتالیایی، ISEE Parificato برای درآمد خارجی، کنترل‌ها، مهلت‌ها و محل کمک را بشناس.
description.ar: افهم تخفيض الرسوم وISEE الإيطالي وISEE Parificato للدخل الأجنبي والرقابة والمواعيد والمساعدة.

title.en: I need university documents or certificates
title.it: Mi servono documenti o certificati universitari

description.en: Request enrolment certificates, exam certificates, mobility documents, EDISU documents, and certificates needed for Questura or ASL.
description.it: Richiedi certificati di iscrizione, esami, mobilita, documenti EDISU e certificati necessari per Questura o ASL.
description.fr: Demandez certificats d inscription, examens, mobilite, documents EDISU et certificats pour Questura ou ASL.
description.es: Solicita certificados de matricula, examenes, movilidad, documentos EDISU y certificados para Questura o ASL.
description.fa: گواهی ثبت‌نام، امتحان، جابه‌جایی، مدارک EDISU و گواهی‌های لازم برای Questura یا ASL را بگیر.
description.ar: اطلب شهادات التسجيل والامتحانات والتنقل ووثائق EDISU والشهادات المطلوبة لـ Questura أو ASL.

title.en: I need help with exams, career, or academic offices
title.it: Mi serve aiuto su esami, carriera o uffici accademici

description.en: Solve common academic problems: enrolment, blocked career, exams, grades, certificates, recognition of credits, thesis, and graduation.
description.it: Risolvi problemi frequenti: iscrizione, carriera bloccata, esami, voti, certificati, riconoscimento crediti, tesi e laurea.
description.fr: Resoudre inscription, carriere bloquee, examens, notes, certificats, reconnaissance de credits, memoire et diplome.
description.es: Resuelve matricula, carrera bloqueada, examenes, notas, certificados, reconocimiento de creditos, tesis y graduacion.
description.fa: مشکلات ثبت‌نام، مسیر تحصیلی بسته، امتحان، نمره، گواهی، انتقال واحد، پایان‌نامه و فارغ‌التحصیلی را حل کن.
description.ar: حل مشاكل التسجيل والمسار المحظور والامتحانات والدرجات والشهادات ومعادلة الساعات والرسالة والتخرج.

title.en: I need housing proof or rental help as a student
title.it: Mi serve prova alloggio o aiuto affitto come studente

description.en: Prepare rental proof for EDISU, Questura, ASL, Comune, ISEE, and understand when an informal housing agreement is not enough.
description.it: Prepara prova affitto per EDISU, Questura, ASL, Comune, ISEE e capisci quando un accordo informale non basta.
description.fr: Preparez les preuves de location pour EDISU, Questura, ASL, Comune, ISEE et comprenez quand un accord informel ne suffit pas.
description.es: Prepara prueba de alquiler para EDISU, Questura, ASL, Comune, ISEE y entiende cuando un acuerdo informal no basta.
description.fa: مدرک اجاره برای EDISU، Questura، ASL، Comune و ISEE آماده کن و بفهم چه زمانی توافق غیررسمی کافی نیست.
description.ar: حضّر إثبات الإيجار لـ EDISU وQuestura وASL وComune وISEE وافهم متى لا يكفي الاتفاق غير الرسمي.

title.en: I need student health or insurance help
title.it: Mi serve aiuto su salute o assicurazione studente

description.en: Understand private insurance, voluntary SSN, ASL registration, family doctor, and what Questura asks for student permits.
description.it: Capisci assicurazione privata, iscrizione volontaria SSN, ASL, medico di base e cosa chiede la Questura per il permesso studenti.
description.fr: Comprendre assurance privee, inscription volontaire SSN, ASL, medecin de famille et demandes Questura.
description.es: Entiende seguro privado, inscripcion voluntaria SSN, ASL, medico de familia y requisitos Questura.
description.fa: بیمه خصوصی، ثبت‌نام داوطلبانه SSN، ASL، پزشک عمومی و مدارک Questura را بفهم.
description.ar: افهم التأمين الخاص والتسجيل الطوعي في SSN وASL وطبيب الأسرة ومتطلبات Questura.

title.it: Mi servono servizi di supporto studente

description.en: Find counselling, disability support, career services, academic-success support, orientation, and help desks at PoliTO and UniTo.
description.it: Trova counselling, supporto disabilita, career service, supporto studio, orientamento e sportelli PoliTO e UniTo.
description.fr: Trouver counselling, handicap, services carriere, soutien academique, orientation et guichets PoliTO/UniTo.
description.es: Encuentra counselling, discapacidad, career service, apoyo academico, orientacion y helpdesks PoliTO/UniTo.
description.fa: مشاوره، پشتیبانی معلولیت، خدمات کاریابی، پشتیبانی تحصیلی، راهنمایی و helpdeskهای PoliTO و UniTo را پیدا کن.
description.ar: اعثر على الاستشارة ودعم الإعاقة وخدمات المهنة والدعم الأكاديمي والتوجيه ومكاتب PoliTO وUniTo.

title.en: I need a formal student request, ticket, or written escalation
title.it: Mi serve una richiesta formale studente, ticket o escalation scritta

description.en: Write the right message to the university, EDISU, Questura support, or student office, with attachments and protocol numbers.
description.it: Scrivi il messaggio giusto a universita, EDISU, supporto Questura o segreteria, con allegati e numeri pratica.
description.fr: Rediger le bon message a l universite, EDISU, Questura ou secretariat, avec pieces jointes et numeros.
description.es: Escribe el mensaje correcto a universidad, EDISU, Questura o secretaria, con adjuntos y numeros.
description.fa: پیام درست به دانشگاه، EDISU، Questura یا دفتر دانشجویی را با پیوست‌ها و شماره پرونده بنویس.
description.ar: اكتب الرسالة الصحيحة للجامعة أو EDISU أو Questura أو مكتب الطلاب مع المرفقات والأرقام.

Ottieni o verifica il codice fiscale prima di banca, affitto, ASL, telefono e pratiche universitarie.

Attiva SPID/CIE/PEC appena possibile.
Usa ticket e portali ufficiali, non email casuali, quando l’universita lo richiede.

items: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.

en: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.
it: Studenti UE che restano 3–12 mesi possono dover fare iscrizione nella popolazione temporanea, non un permesso.
Studenti extra-UE fino a 90 giorni possono dover fare dichiarazione di presenza secondo ingresso e alloggio.
Studenti in mobilita con permesso di altro Paese UE possono essere esenti dal permesso italiano solo se tutte le condizioni sono rispettate.
Se salti l’appuntamento in Questura, la pratica puo essere sospesa.
Se il primo soggiorno supera un anno, potrebbe servire firmare l’Accordo di Integrazione.

items: You and your family income/assets are in Italy: ordinary ISEE may be enough.
Your family income/assets are abroad: ISEE Parificato is commonly required.
You are independent from family: check the university/EDISU rules very carefully before assuming this.
You apply for EDISU scholarship: follow the current EDISU call.
You only need tuition reduction: follow your university fee rules.
If documents are foreign, check translation, legalization, apostille, and country-specific rules before paying.

it: Tu e redditi/patrimoni familiari siete in Italia: l’ISEE ordinario puo bastare.
Redditi/patrimoni familiari sono all’estero: spesso serve ISEE Parificato.

Fai domanda borsa EDISU: segui il bando EDISU attuale.
Ti serve solo riduzione tasse: segui le regole tasse del tuo ateneo.
Se i documenti sono esteri, controlla traduzione, legalizzazione, apostille e regole per Paese prima di pagare.

items: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.

en: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.
it: Primo rinnovo: almeno un esame superato.
Rinnovi successivi: almeno due esami per anno accademico.
Chiedi all’ufficio universitario se il tuo caso e speciale, per esempio dottorato, mobilita, anno solo tesi o corso senza esami ordinari.
La Questura puo chiedere documenti aggiuntivi in casi individuali.

items: Certificate of enrolment for the current academic year.

Stamp duty if the university requires it for official certificates.
Printed certificate if online certificate is not accepted for your case.
Clarification from student office if your exams are not visible yet.

items: Check the exact certificate requested by Questura or the university immigration page.
Download it from the student portal if available.
If not available, open a ticket to the student office.
Mention that it is for residence permit renewal.
Ask whether it must show exams, credits, and academic year.
Save the certificate as PDF and print a copy for the kit or Questura appointment.
If an exam is missing from the certificate, attach proof or ask office to update the record.

title.en: I need to write a clear formal message

description.en: Write short, polite, clear emails or PEC messages for offices, companies, landlords, universities, banks, and providers.
description.it: Scrivi email o PEC brevi, gentili e chiare per uffici, aziende, proprietari, università, banche e fornitori.
description.fr: Écrire des emails ou PEC courts, polis et clairs pour bureaux, entreprises, propriétaires, universités, banques et fournisseurs.
description.es: Escribe emails o PEC breves, educados y claros para oficinas, empresas, propietarios, universidades, bancos y proveedores.
description.fa: ایمیل یا PEC کوتاه، محترمانه و واضح برای ادارات، شرکت‌ها، صاحبخانه، دانشگاه، بانک و ارائه‌دهندگان بنویس.

description.es: Envía PEC correctamente, adjunta documentos, nombra archivos claramente y guarda pruebas de entrega.
description.fa: PEC را درست بفرست، مدارک را پیوست کن، فایل‌ها را واضح نام‌گذاری کن و رسید تحویل را نگه دار.
description.ar: أرسل PEC بشكل صحيح، أرفق المستندات، سمّ الملفات بوضوح واحتفظ بإثبات التسليم.

title.en: I need follow-up, protocol, or proof that they received it
title.it: Mi serve follow-up, protocollo o prova di ricezione

description.en: Ask for updates when an office, company, university, provider, or landlord has not replied.
description.it: Chiedi aggiornamenti quando ufficio, azienda, università, fornitore o proprietario non risponde.
description.fr: Demander des nouvelles lorsqu’un bureau, une entreprise, une université, un fournisseur ou un propriétaire ne répond pas.
description.es: Pide actualizaciones cuando oficina, empresa, universidad, proveedor o propietario no responde.
description.fa: وقتی اداره، شرکت، دانشگاه، ارائه‌دهنده یا صاحبخانه پاسخ نمی‌دهد، پیگیری کن.
description.ar: اطلب تحديثاً عندما لا يرد مكتب أو شركة أو جامعة أو مزود أو مالك.

title.en: They asked for missing documents or rejected the request
title.it: Mi hanno chiesto integrazioni o hanno respinto la pratica

description.en: Reply when an office rejects, pauses, or asks you to integrate a request.
description.it: Rispondi quando un ufficio respinge, sospende o chiede integrazione su una richiesta.
description.fr: Répondre lorsqu’un bureau rejette, suspend ou demande des compléments.
description.es: Responde cuando una oficina rechaza, suspende o pide integración.
description.fa: وقتی اداره درخواست را رد، متوقف یا مدارک تکمیلی می‌خواهد پاسخ بده.
description.ar: رد عندما يرفض مكتب طلباً أو يعلقه أو يطلب استكمال مستندات.

title.en: I need refund, payment, or correction help
title.it: Mi serve aiuto su rimborso, pagamento o correzione

description.en: Ask for refunds, clarify payments, correct wrong charges, and prepare proof before contacting an office or company.
description.it: Chiedi rimborsi, chiarisci pagamenti, correggi addebiti sbagliati e prepara prove prima di contattare uffici o aziende.
description.fr: Demander remboursements, clarifier paiements, corriger frais et préparer preuves.
description.es: Pide reembolsos, aclara pagos, corrige cargos y prepara pruebas.
description.fa: درخواست بازپرداخت، روشن کردن پرداخت، اصلاح هزینه اشتباه و آماده کردن مدارک.
description.ar: اطلب الاسترداد ووضح المدفوعات وصحح الرسوم وحضّر الأدلة.

title.en: I need to organize proof and documents

description.en: Organize receipts, screenshots, contracts, protocol numbers, emails, PEC receipts, bills, and office replies before sending requests.
description.it: Organizza ricevute, screenshot, contratti, protocolli, email, ricevute PEC, bollette e risposte uffici prima di inviare richieste.
description.fr: Organiser reçus, captures, contrats, protocoles, emails, PEC, factures et réponses.
description.es: Organiza recibos, capturas, contratos, protocolos, emails, PEC, facturas y respuestas.
description.fa: رسیدها، اسکرین‌شات‌ها، قراردادها، پروتکل‌ها، ایمیل‌ها، رسید PEC، قبض‌ها و پاسخ‌ها را مرتب کن.
description.ar: نظّم الإيصالات واللقطات والعقود والبروتوكولات والبريد وPEC والفواتير والردود.

title.en: I need an appointment or I have to call the office
title.it: Mi serve un appuntamento o devo chiamare l'ufficio

description.en: Prepare for public-office appointments, CAF, patronato, ASL, university, bank, landlord, or provider calls.
description.it: Preparati per appuntamenti con uffici, CAF, patronato, ASL, università, banca, proprietario o fornitori.
description.fr: Se préparer aux rendez-vous avec bureaux, CAF, patronato, ASL, université, banque, propriétaire ou fournisseurs.
description.es: Prepárate para citas con oficinas, CAF, patronato, ASL, universidad, banco, propietario o proveedores.
description.fa: برای وقت با ادارات، CAF، patronato، ASL، دانشگاه، بانک، صاحبخانه یا ارائه‌دهندگان آماده شو.
description.ar: استعد للمواعيد مع المكاتب وCAF وpatronato وASL والجامعة والبنك والمالك والمزودين.

title.en: I still do not know where to start
title.it: Ancora non so da dove iniziare

description.en: Send your case, ask us to add the missing problem, or request private help when the situation does not match any guide.
description.it: Invia il tuo caso, chiedi di aggiungere il problema mancante o richiedi aiuto privato quando la situazione non rientra in nessuna guida.
description.fr: Envoyez votre cas, demandez l’ajout du problème manquant ou demandez une aide privée.
description.es: Envía tu caso, pide añadir el problema faltante o solicita ayuda privada.
description.fa: پرونده‌ات را بفرست، بخواه مشکل اضافه شود یا وقتی هیچ راهنما مناسب نیست کمک خصوصی بگیر.
description.ar: أرسل حالتك، اطلب إضافة المشكلة الناقصة أو اطلب مساعدة خاصة.

items: Ask: who issued the document or bill?
Ask: who rejected the request?
Ask: who can change the official record?
Ask: is this a public-office issue, contract issue, payment issue, or legal dispute?
If there is a protocol number, start from the office that issued it.
If money was charged by a company, start from that company’s complaint channel.
If there is a deadline or legal paper, do not wait for informal replies.
If unsure, send a short information request before sending a full formal complaint.

items: Low ISEE + bills: check bonus sociale for electricity, gas, water, and waste.
Children: check Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido, Bonus nuovi nati, and school benefits.
Rent difficulty: check Regione/Comune rent support and emergency housing paths.
University student: check EDISU, tuition reduction, ISEE/ISEE Parificato, and rental proof.
School-age child in Piemonte: check Voucher scuola Piemonte.
Disability or serious health condition: check ADI, disability-linked INPS benefits, bonus sociale disagio fisico, and local support.
Unemployed or fragile household: check NASpI, ADI, SFL, Comune social services, and patronato.
Psychological support: check Bonus psicologo only when the INPS application window is open.
Automatic benefits: check that ISEE, household, IBAN, and contract-holder data are correct.

items: Likely relevant: conditions look close, verify the official page.
Maybe relevant: one or more key details are missing.
Not for you: the benefit is for a different group.
Automatic: no normal application, but data must be correct.
Seasonal: exists, but the application window may be closed.
Local: depends on Regione or Comune, not only national rules.
Needs CAF or patronato: do not try alone if documents are complex.
Needs official confirmation: rules changed recently or the case is unusual.

body.en: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.it: Un contributo, un prestito, una garanzia pubblica e una sospensione rate risolvono problemi diversi. Se li confondi, puoi firmare un debito quando ti serviva un beneficio, oppure aspettarti soldi gratuiti da qualcosa che va restituito.
body.fr: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.es: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.fa: Un contributo, un prestito, una garanzia pubblica e una sospensione rate risolvono problemi diversi. Se li confondi, puoi firmare un debito quando ti serviva un beneficio, oppure aspettarti soldi gratuiti da qualcosa che va restituito.
body.ar: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.

items: Grant or bonus: money/support you usually do not repay, if you meet the rules.
Loan: money you borrow and must repay, usually with interest and fees.
Credit line: money you can use up to a limit, then repay later.
Public guarantee: the State helps the bank reduce risk, but you still owe the bank.
Mortgage suspension: temporary pause in payments, not cancellation of the debt.
Personal loan: credit for personal needs, with instalments and total cost.
Student honor loan: usually a credit line during study, then repayment starts later.
Payment plan: divides a debt into instalments; it does not erase the debt.

en: Grant or bonus: money/support you usually do not repay, if you meet the rules.
Loan: money you borrow and must repay, usually with interest and fees.
Credit line: money you can use up to a limit, then repay later.
Public guarantee: the State helps the bank reduce risk, but you still owe the bank.
Mortgage suspension: temporary pause in payments, not cancellation of the debt.
Personal loan: credit for personal needs, with instalments and total cost.
Student honor loan: usually a credit line during study, then repayment starts later.
Payment plan: divides a debt into instalments; it does not erase the debt.
it: Contributo o bonus: soldi/supporto che di solito non devi restituire, se rispetti le regole.
Prestito: soldi che prendi in prestito e devi restituire, spesso con interessi e spese.
Linea di credito: importo che puoi usare entro un limite e rimborsare dopo.
Garanzia pubblica: lo Stato aiuta la banca a ridurre il rischio, ma il debito resta tuo.
Sospensione mutuo: pausa temporanea delle rate, non cancellazione del debito.
Prestito personale: credito per esigenze personali, con rate e costo totale.
Prestito d’onore studenti: spesso linea di credito durante lo studio, poi rimborso successivo.
Piano di rientro: divide un debito in rate; non cancella il debito.

items: Check if a grant, bonus, scholarship or public support exists first.
Check if you can delay, reduce, or split the payment without taking a loan.
Calculate total amount to repay, not only the monthly instalment.
Check TAEG, not only TAN.
Check whether insurance is optional or required.
Check late-payment consequences.
Check early-repayment rules.
Ask what happens if your income drops.
Do not sign under pressure or during a phone call without written documents.

it: Controlla prima se esiste contributo, bonus, borsa o sostegno pubblico.
Verifica se puoi rinviare, ridurre o rateizzare il pagamento senza prestito.
Calcola l’importo totale da restituire, non solo la rata mensile.
Controlla il TAEG, non solo il TAN.
Verifica se l’assicurazione è facoltativa o obbligatoria.
Controlla le conseguenze dei ritardi.
Controlla le regole di rimborso anticipato.
Chiedi cosa succede se il reddito diminuisce.
Non firmare sotto pressione o al telefono senza documenti scritti.

items: For students aged 18 to 40.
For merit-based study paths listed by the Fund.
Can cover university, master, specialisation school, PhD, language courses and ITS Academy paths where eligible.
Managed through MyConsap and participating banks.
Annual tranches up to €15,000 for each remaining study year.
Maximum €50,000, or up to €70,000 for study abroad.
Later tranches depend on enrolment in later years and merit/progress requirements.
Repayment can be from 3 to 15 years.
Repayment cannot start before the 30th month after the last tranche.
Banks should not ask for extra guarantees beyond the State guarantee.

Gestito tramite MyConsap e banche aderenti.
Tranche annuali fino a 15.000 € per ogni anno residuo di corso.
Massimo 50.000 €, o fino a 70.000 € per studio all’estero.
Le tranche successive dipendono dall’iscrizione agli anni successivi e dai requisiti di merito/progresso.
Rimborso da 3 a 15 anni.
Il rimborso non può iniziare prima del 30° mese dall’ultima tranche.
Le banche non dovrebbero chiedere garanzie aggiuntive oltre alla garanzia statale.

L’immobile deve essere prima casa e rispettare le regole del Fondo.
La banca valuta comunque se concedere il mutuo.
La garanzia riduce il rischio della banca, non il tuo debito.

body.en: You are domiciled in Torino for study, work, or another temporary reason and you need a doctor or healthcare access here without moving your official residence.

body.es: You are domiciled in Torino for study, work, or another temporary reason and you need a doctor or healthcare access here without moving your official residence.

items: Identity document and codice fiscale.
Proof of residence elsewhere in Italy.
Proof that you actually live in Torino now: rental contract, university housing, hospitality declaration, or employer note.
Document that explains why you are in Torino: university enrollment, work contract, internship, or similar.

en: Identity document and codice fiscale.
Proof of residence elsewhere in Italy.
Proof that you actually live in Torino now: rental contract, university housing, hospitality declaration, or employer note.
Document that explains why you are in Torino: university enrollment, work contract, internship, or similar.
it: Documento e codice fiscale.
Prova della residenza in un altro Comune italiano.
Prova che vivi davvero a Torino adesso: contratto di affitto, alloggio universitario, dichiarazione di ospitalita o nota del datore.
Documento che spiega perche sei a Torino: iscrizione universitaria, contratto di lavoro, tirocinio o simili.

items: Check first whether the doctor-choice service can already handle your temporary domicile case online.
If not, go to the ASL administrative counter with both residence and Torino domicile documents.
Ask for temporary healthcare assistance or the route that lets you choose a doctor in Torino for the period you stay here.

en: Check first whether the doctor-choice service can already handle your temporary domicile case online.
If not, go to the ASL administrative counter with both residence and Torino domicile documents.
Ask for temporary healthcare assistance or the route that lets you choose a doctor in Torino for the period you stay here.
it: Controlla prima se il servizio scelta medico gestisce gia online il tuo caso di domicilio temporaneo.
Se non basta, vai allo sportello amministrativo ASL con documenti di residenza e domicilio torinese.
Chiedi l'assistenza sanitaria temporanea o il percorso che ti permette di scegliere un medico a Torino per il periodo in cui resti qui.

body.en: Arriving with only a university badge or a verbal address is usually not enough. Torino ASL usually wants real address evidence plus the reason why you are staying here.
body.it: Presentarsi solo con badge universitario o indirizzo detto a voce di solito non basta. L'ASL di Torino vuole una prova reale dell'indirizzo e del motivo per cui sei qui.

items: Questura: permesso di soggiorno, fingerprints, police appointments, permit collection.
Poste Sportello Amico: yellow kit collection and submission for many permit types.
Comune / Anagrafe: residence, address change, CIE identity card, certificates, family status, temporary population register.
Agenzia Entrate: codice fiscale, tax-code certificate, tax office issues.
ASL: healthcare registration, family doctor, health card position, exemptions.
CAF: ISEE, tax declarations, some bonus applications, income paperwork.
Patronato: INPS, NASpI, pensions, social security and many welfare applications.
University or EDISU: student enrollment, scholarship, university housing, student-specific certificates.
Poste Italiane: registered mail, postal kit receipt, some payment slips and appointment services.

Agenzia Entrate: codice fiscale, certificato codice fiscale, problemi fiscali.
ASL: iscrizione sanitaria, medico di base, posizione tessera sanitaria, esenzioni.
CAF: ISEE, dichiarazioni fiscali, alcuni bonus, documenti reddituali.
Patronato: INPS, NASpI, pensioni, previdenza e molte domande sociali.
Università o EDISU: iscrizione universitaria, borsa di studio, alloggi studenti, certificati per studenti.
Poste Italiane: raccomandate, ricevuta kit postale, alcuni bollettini e servizi su appuntamento.

items: If you are non-EU: check visa, permit kit deadline, and Questura/Poste path first.
Get or verify codice fiscale because almost every other office needs it.
Secure housing proof: rental contract, hospitality declaration, or residence/domicile proof.
Start residence only when you actually live at the address.
Prepare name on doorbell and mailbox before residence checks.
Set up SPID/CIE/PEC as soon as documents allow it.
Use ASL only for healthcare, not for residence or permit issues.
Keep every receipt, protocol number, appointment slip, and screenshot.

en: If you are non-EU: check visa, permit kit deadline, and Questura/Poste path first.
Get or verify codice fiscale because almost every other office needs it.
Secure housing proof: rental contract, hospitality declaration, or residence/domicile proof.
Start residence only when you actually live at the address.
Prepare name on doorbell and mailbox before residence checks.
Set up SPID/CIE/PEC as soon as documents allow it.
Use ASL only for healthcare, not for residence or permit issues.
Keep every receipt, protocol number, appointment slip, and screenshot.
it: Se sei extra-UE: controlla prima visto, scadenza kit permesso e percorso Questura/Poste.
Ottieni o verifica il codice fiscale perché quasi tutti gli altri uffici lo chiedono.
Metti in ordine la prova dell’alloggio: contratto, ospitalità o prova di residenza/domicilio.
Avvia la residenza solo quando vivi davvero all’indirizzo.
Prepara nome su citofono e cassetta prima dei controlli residenza.
Attiva SPID/CIE/PEC appena i documenti lo permettono.
Usa ASL solo per sanità, non per residenza o permesso.
Conserva ogni ricevuta, protocollo, convocazione e screenshot.

body.en: In Torino, Anagrafe centrale is in Via della Consolata 23. Residence and address-change procedures are mainly online, but the central office provides information and specific appointment support.

Patronato: INPS, NASpI, pensioni, previdenza e molte domande sociali.
Università o EDISU: iscrizione universitaria, borsa di studio, alloggi studenti, certificati per studenti.
Poste Italiane: raccomandate, ricevuta kit postale, alcuni bollettini e servizi su appuntamento.

Start residence only when you actually live at the address.

Set up SPID/CIE/PEC as soon as documents allow it.
Use ASL only for healthcare, not for residence or permit issues.
Keep every receipt, protocol number, appointment slip, and screenshot.

Start residence only when you actually live at the address.

it: Se sei extra-UE: controlla prima visto, scadenza kit permesso e percorso Questura/Poste.
Ottieni o verifica il codice fiscale perché quasi tutti gli altri uffici lo chiedono.
Metti in ordine la prova dell’alloggio: contratto, ospitalità o prova di residenza/domicilio.
Avvia la residenza solo quando vivi davvero all’indirizzo.
Prepara nome su citofono e cassetta prima dei controlli residenza.
Attiva SPID/CIE/PEC appena i documenti lo permettono.
Usa ASL solo per sanità, non per residenza o permesso.
Conserva ogni ricevuta, protocollo, convocazione e screenshot.

Ask Agenzia Entrate for correction or alignment.

Keep proof of correction.

body.en: Many Italian public procedures are online or require formal proof of sending. These tools let you log in, send official communications, track requests, and avoid losing deadlines.
body.it: Molte pratiche pubbliche italiane sono online o richiedono prova formale di invio. Questi strumenti servono per accedere, inviare comunicazioni ufficiali, seguire pratiche ed evitare scadenze perse.
body.fr: Many Italian public procedures are online or require formal proof of sending. These tools let you log in, send official communications, track requests, and avoid losing deadlines.

body.ar: Many Italian public procedures are online or require formal proof of sending. These tools let you log in, send official communications, track requests, and avoid losing deadlines.

items: Codice fiscale: tax identification code used almost everywhere.
SPID: digital identity to access many public and private online services.
CIE: electronic identity card; can also be used for online login with CieID.
CNS / health card: smart-card access method if activated with PIN.
PEC: certified email with legal proof when sent to another PEC.
Protocol number: official tracking number for a request submitted to an office.
Receipt / ricevuta: proof that a request, kit, PEC, or online form was submitted.

CNS / health card: smart-card access method if activated with PIN.
PEC: certified email with legal proof when sent to another PEC.

it: Codice fiscale: codice identificativo fiscale usato quasi ovunque.
SPID: identità digitale per accedere a molti servizi online pubblici e privati.
CIE: carta d’identità elettronica; può servire anche per accesso online con CieID.
CNS / tessera sanitaria: metodo di accesso con smart card se attivato con PIN.
PEC: email certificata con prova legale quando inviata a un’altra PEC.
Numero di protocollo: numero ufficiale per seguire una richiesta inviata a un ufficio.
Ricevuta: prova che una richiesta, kit, PEC o modulo online è stato inviato.

title.en: Best order to set them up
title.fr: Best order to set them up
title.es: Best order to set them up
title.ar: Best order to set them up

items: Get codice fiscale first.
Get or request CIE if you are resident or eligible.
Activate SPID when you have a valid Italian identity document and tax-code document.
Activate CIE online login with CieID if you have CIE and PIN/PUK.
Get PEC when you need formal requests or deadline-sensitive communication.
Keep protocol numbers and receipts in one folder.

it: Ottieni prima il codice fiscale.
Richiedi la CIE se sei residente o hai i requisiti.
Attiva SPID quando hai documento italiano valido e documento codice fiscale.
Attiva accesso CIE online con CieID se hai CIE e PIN/PUK.
Attiva PEC quando ti servono richieste formali o comunicazioni con scadenza.
Conserva protocolli e ricevute in una sola cartella.

it: Devi avere almeno 18 anni.
Documento italiano valido: carta d’identità, patente o passaporto.
Tessera sanitaria, tesserino codice fiscale o certificato di attribuzione.
Indirizzo email.
Numero di cellulare.
Metodo di riconoscimento: di persona, webcam, audio-video con bonifico, CIE, CNS o firma digitale.

items: Open the official SPID provider list.
Choose a provider based on recognition method, cost, time, and support.
Register on the provider website.
Enter your personal data exactly as written on your document.
Create credentials.
Complete recognition.
Activate two-factor authentication if required.
Test SPID on a public service before an urgent deadline.

it: Apri la lista ufficiale dei gestori SPID.
Scegli un gestore in base a riconoscimento, costo, tempi e assistenza.
Registrati sul sito del gestore.
Inserisci i dati anagrafici esattamente come nel documento.
Crea le credenziali.
Completa il riconoscimento.
Attiva l’autenticazione a due fattori se richiesta.
Prova SPID su un servizio pubblico prima di una scadenza urgente.

body.en: SPID cannot normally be requested using only the permesso di soggiorno. SPID’s official guide says foreign citizens in Italy can use the residence permit to obtain the identity card, which is then useful for requesting SPID.
body.it: Normalmente non si può richiedere SPID usando solo il permesso di soggiorno. La guida ufficiale SPID indica che i cittadini stranieri in Italia possono usare il permesso per ottenere la carta d’identità, utile poi per richiedere SPID.

items: Check that your permit type uses the yellow postal kit.
Get the kit from Poste Sportello Amico.
Read the instructions before writing.
Fill it carefully in black pen or as instructed.
Add copies, not originals, unless instructions require otherwise.
Prepare payment slips and marca da bollo if required.
Submit the kit open at Sportello Amico.
Pay the required amounts at Poste.
Keep the postal receipt and appointment sheet.
Remember the postal receipt is not the final permesso.
Go to the Questura appointment later for fingerprints.
Track the practice on Portale Immigrazione or Questura tools.

it: Controlla che il tuo tipo di permesso usi il kit giallo.
Ritira il kit allo Sportello Amico.
Leggi le istruzioni prima di scrivere.
Compilalo con attenzione in penna nera o come indicato.
Aggiungi copie, non originali, salvo istruzioni diverse.
Prepara bollettini e marca da bollo se richiesti.
Consegna il kit aperto allo Sportello Amico.
Paga gli importi richiesti in Poste.
Conserva ricevuta postale e foglio convocazione.

Vai poi all’appuntamento in Questura per le impronte.
Segui la pratica su Portale Immigrazione o strumenti Questura.

items: The central Anagrafe office is Via della Consolata 23.

body.en: Comune Torino says the declaration must be submitted within 20 days from the move. The procedure normally completes within 45 days, including the local police check. If the office sends a pre-rejection notice before the deadline, reply quickly.

items: Put your surname on the doorbell.
Put your surname on the mailbox.
Make sure the building number is visible.
Check staircase, floor, apartment number, and internal number.
Tell roommates or family that a local police check may happen.
Make sure someone can open or answer if you are not home.
Keep rental contract or hospitality proof available.
If the name cannot be added permanently, add a temporary but clear label.

it: Metti il cognome sul citofono.
Metti il cognome sulla cassetta postale.
Assicurati che il numero civico sia visibile.
Controlla scala, piano, numero appartamento e interno.
Avvisa coinquilini o familiari che può passare la Polizia Locale.
Assicurati che qualcuno possa aprire o rispondere se non sei in casa.
Tieni disponibile contratto o prova di ospitalità.
Se il nome non può essere aggiunto stabilmente, metti un’etichetta temporanea ma chiara.

items: Put your surname on the doorbell.
Put your surname on the mailbox.
Make sure the building number is visible.
Check staircase, floor, apartment number, and internal number.

Keep rental contract or hospitality proof available.
If the name cannot be added permanently, add a temporary but clear label.
