Put your surname on the mailbox.
Make sure the building number is visible.
Check staircase, floor, apartment number, and internal number.

it: Metti il cognome sul citofono.
Metti il cognome sulla cassetta postale.
Assicurati che il numero civico sia visibile.
Controlla scala, piano, numero appartamento e interno.
Avvisa coinquilini o familiari che può passare la Polizia Locale.
Assicurati che qualcuno possa aprire o rispondere se non sei in casa.
Tieni disponibile contratto o prova di ospitalità.
Se il nome non può essere aggiunto stabilmente, metti un’etichetta temporanea ma chiara.

it: Leggi bene il messaggio del Comune.

body.en: Work problems in Italy split between different offices. If you ask the wrong place, you lose time. INPS handles benefits, but unpaid salary or a bad contract is usually not solved by INPS.
body.it: I problemi di lavoro in Italia si dividono tra uffici diversi. Se chiedi al posto sbagliato, perdi tempo. INPS gestisce prestazioni, ma stipendio non pagato o contratto scorretto di solito non si risolvono con INPS.

body.en: INPS says the application must be sent within 68 days from the end of the employment relationship and only after the work relationship has ended. If you apply within the first eight days, NASpI can start from the eighth day after the end of work; otherwise it normally starts from the day after the application.
body.it: INPS indica che la domanda deve essere inviata entro 68 giorni dalla cessazione del rapporto e solo dopo la fine del rapporto di lavoro. Se invii entro i primi otto giorni, la NASpI può decorrere dall’ottavo giorno dopo la cessazione; altrimenti di solito decorre dal giorno successivo alla domanda.

body.en: INPS says the application must be sent within 68 days from the end of the employment relationship and only after the work relationship has ended. If you apply within the first eight days, NASpI can start from the eighth day after the end of work; otherwise it normally starts from the day after the application.
body.it: INPS indica che la domanda deve essere inviata entro 68 giorni dalla cessazione del rapporto e solo dopo la fine del rapporto di lavoro. Se invii entro i primi otto giorni, la NASpI può decorrere dall’ottavo giorno dopo la cessazione; altrimenti di solito decorre dal giorno successivo alla domanda.

items: Send a short written request to HR or the employer.
List the documents you need.

title.es: What changes when you open it

items: You issue invoices.
You choose ATECO code and tax regime.
You may need electronic invoicing.
You pay taxes and contributions through deadlines.
You may need INPS Gestione Separata, artisans/commerce fund, or a professional pension fund.
You must keep accounting records or pay an accountant.
You must check whether your residence permit allows self-employment.

en: You issue invoices.

You may need electronic invoicing.
You pay taxes and contributions through deadlines.
You may need INPS Gestione Separata, artisans/commerce fund, or a professional pension fund.

it: Emetti fatture.
Scegli codice ATECO e regime fiscale.
Può servire fatturazione elettronica.
Paghi tasse e contributi a scadenze.
Può servire Gestione Separata INPS, gestione artigiani/commercianti o cassa professionale.
Devi tenere contabilità o pagare un commercialista.
Devi verificare se il tuo permesso consente lavoro autonomo.

items: You work like an employee but they ask you to open partita IVA.
You have only one client who controls your schedule and work.
You do not know how much taxes and contributions will cost.
You need stable employee rights such as paid holidays, sick leave, and unemployment protection.
You are a non-EU citizen and your permit does not allow that activity.
The client promises a net amount but does not explain taxes and INPS.
You cannot freely organize time, price, method, or place of work.

en: You work like an employee but they ask you to open partita IVA.

it: Lavori come dipendente ma ti chiedono di aprire partita IVA.
Hai un solo cliente che decide orari e lavoro.
Non sai quanto costeranno tasse e contributi.
Ti servono tutele da dipendente come ferie, malattia e disoccupazione.
Sei extra-UE e il tuo permesso non consente quell’attività.
Il cliente promette un netto ma non spiega tasse e INPS.
Non puoi organizzare liberamente tempi, prezzo, metodo o luogo di lavoro.

body.en: For individuals and self-employed workers, partita IVA is opened by filing the correct start-of-activity declaration with Agenzia Entrate. Many people use a commercialista because ATECO code, tax regime, and INPS position must be chosen correctly.
body.it: Per persone fisiche e lavoratori autonomi, la partita IVA si apre presentando la dichiarazione di inizio attività all’Agenzia Entrate. Molti usano un commercialista perché codice ATECO, regime fiscale e posizione INPS vanno scelti bene.

body.ar: For individuals and self-employed workers, partita IVA is opened by filing the correct start-of-activity declaration with Agenzia Entrate. Many people use a commercialista because ATECO code, tax regime, and INPS position must be chosen correctly.

items: Check whether your activity is professional, commercial, artisan, or another type.
Choose the correct ATECO code.
Check whether you can use regime forfettario.
Check whether you need Gestione Separata, artisans/commerce INPS, or a professional pension fund.
Check if you need SCIA, Camera di Commercio, insurance, or other authorization.
Check if your residence permit allows self-employed work.
Estimate taxes, INPS contributions, accountant cost, and first-year cash flow.
Ask how invoices, F24, and yearly tax return will work.

body.en: Sometimes a company asks someone to open partita IVA to avoid hiring them as an employee. If they control your schedule, tools, place of work, and tasks like an employer, the situation can be risky.
body.it: A volte un’azienda chiede di aprire partita IVA per evitare un’assunzione. Se controlla orari, strumenti, luogo e mansioni come un datore di lavoro, la situazione può essere rischiosa.
body.fr: Sometimes a company asks someone to open partita IVA to avoid hiring them as an employee. If they control your schedule, tools, place of work, and tasks like an employer, the situation can be risky.
body.es: Sometimes a company asks someone to open partita IVA to avoid hiring them as an employee. If they control your schedule, tools, place of work, and tasks like an employer, the situation can be risky.
body.fa: A volte un’azienda chiede di aprire partita IVA per evitare un’assunzione. Se controlla orari, strumenti, luogo e mansioni come un datore di lavoro, la situazione può essere rischiosa.
body.ar: Sometimes a company asks someone to open partita IVA to avoid hiring them as an employee. If they control your schedule, tools, place of work, and tasks like an employer, the situation can be risky.

items: Only one client.
Fixed working hours decided by the client.
Client controls how and where you work.
You cannot choose prices or negotiate real conditions.
You work inside the company like employees.
You use company tools and follow company managers daily.
You need permission for holidays or absences.
You have no paid holidays, sick leave, or unemployment protection.
They promise a net amount but ignore taxes and contributions.
They tell you partita IVA is mandatory but the work looks like employee work.

it: Un solo cliente.
Orari fissi decisi dal cliente.
Il cliente controlla come e dove lavori.
Non scegli prezzi o condizioni reali.
Lavori dentro l’azienda come i dipendenti.
Usi strumenti aziendali e rispondi ogni giorno a responsabili aziendali.
Devi chiedere permesso per ferie o assenze.
Non hai ferie pagate, malattia o protezione disoccupazione.
Promettono un netto ma ignorano tasse e contributi.
Dicono che la partita IVA è obbligatoria ma il lavoro sembra dipendente.

items: Ask for a written proposal.

Ask if you can work for other clients.
Ask whether you choose time, method, and place of work.
Ask a commercialista to estimate real net income.
Ask a union/legal adviser if the work looks employee-like.
Check whether your permit allows self-employment.

body.en: Student problems in Torino are split between university offices and public offices. The university can support you, but it cannot replace Questura, ASL, Comune, CAF, or EDISU decisions.

body.ar: Student problems in Torino are split between university offices and public offices. The university can support you, but it cannot replace Questura, ASL, Comune, CAF, or EDISU decisions.

items: PoliTO or UniTo: enrolment, academic career, exams, grades, certificates, student records, degree programme problems.
EDISU Piemonte: scholarships, student housing, canteens, study rooms, grants, benefit applications, EDISU ticketing.
Questura: residence permit, fingerprints, permit status, permit collection, declaration of presence when required.
Poste / Sportello Amico: postal kit submission for many residence-permit applications and renewals.
Comune / Anagrafe: residenza, temporary residence, address certificates, CIE identity card.
ASL: SSN registration, family doctor, health card, public healthcare access, ticket exemptions.
CAF: ISEE, ISEE Parificato, income and family documents for fees, EDISU, and benefits.
Landlord or tenant union: rental contract, deposit, rent proof, housing disputes.
Patronato: INPS, NASpI, social-security or welfare applications if you work or lose work.

it: PoliTO o UniTo: iscrizione, carriera, esami, voti, certificati, segreteria studenti, problemi del corso di studio.
EDISU Piemonte: borse di studio, residenze, mense, sale studio, contributi, domande benefici, ticketing EDISU.
Questura: permesso di soggiorno, impronte, stato pratica, ritiro permesso, dichiarazione di presenza quando richiesta.
Poste / Sportello Amico: consegna kit postale per molte domande e rinnovi permesso.
Comune / Anagrafe: residenza, residenza temporanea, certificati indirizzo, carta d’identita CIE.
ASL: iscrizione SSN, medico di base, tessera sanitaria, accesso alla sanita pubblica, esenzioni ticket.
CAF: ISEE, ISEE Parificato, documenti reddito e famiglia per tasse, EDISU e benefici.
Proprietario o sindacato inquilini: contratto affitto, deposito, prova alloggio, problemi casa.
Patronato: INPS, NASpI, previdenza o prestazioni sociali se lavori o perdi il lavoro.

items: Non-EU with type D study visa: prepare residence permit application quickly after arrival.
EU staying 3–12 months: check temporary population registration rules.
Get or verify codice fiscale before bank, rent, ASL, phone, and university paperwork.
Organize health insurance or SSN registration before permit renewal deadlines.
Keep rental proof strong enough for EDISU, Questura, ASL, Comune, and ISEE.
Set up SPID/CIE/PEC as soon as you can.
Use official tickets and portals, not random emails, when the university tells you to.

it: Extra-UE con visto studio D: prepara rapidamente la domanda di permesso dopo l’arrivo.

Usa ticket e portali ufficiali, non email casuali, quando l’universita lo richiede.

Book university immigration support if available.
Prepare originals and photocopies.
Complete the postal kit or get support from Immigration Desk/Patronato.
Submit the open kit at Poste Sportello Amico.

Attend Questura fingerprint appointment with original documents and photos.
Track status on Portale Immigrazione or Polizia di Stato tools.
Renew before expiry; do not wait until after the permit expires.

items: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.

en: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.
it: Studenti UE che restano 3–12 mesi possono dover fare iscrizione nella popolazione temporanea, non un permesso.
Studenti extra-UE fino a 90 giorni possono dover fare dichiarazione di presenza secondo ingresso e alloggio.
Studenti in mobilita con permesso di altro Paese UE possono essere esenti dal permesso italiano solo se tutte le condizioni sono rispettate.
Se salti l’appuntamento in Questura, la pratica puo essere sospesa.
Se il primo soggiorno supera un anno, potrebbe servire firmare l’Accordo di Integrazione.

title.it: Documenti spesso richiesti per il rinnovo

items: Expiring or expired residence permit, front and back copies.

Proof of financial resources.
Health insurance receipt covering the renewal period.
Housing proof if requested.
Postal kit papers and payment receipts.

items: Check whether your case needs residence permit, declaration of presence, or temporary residence registration.
Book university immigration support if available.
Prepare originals and photocopies.
Complete the postal kit or get support from Immigration Desk/Patronato.
Submit the open kit at Poste Sportello Amico.
Keep the postal receipt with USER ID and PASSWORD.
Carry passport and receipt until the permit is issued.
Attend Questura fingerprint appointment with original documents and photos.
Track status on Portale Immigrazione or Polizia di Stato tools.
Renew before expiry; do not wait until after the permit expires.

it: Controlla se nel tuo caso serve permesso, dichiarazione di presenza o iscrizione temporanea.
Prenota supporto immigrazione universitario se disponibile.
Prepara originali e fotocopie.
Compila il kit postale o fatti aiutare da Immigration Desk/Patronato.
Consegna il kit aperto allo Sportello Amico Poste.
Conserva ricevuta postale con USER ID e PASSWORD.
Porta sempre passaporto e ricevuta finche il permesso non e rilasciato.
Vai all’appuntamento impronte in Questura con originali e foto.
Controlla lo stato su Portale Immigrazione o strumenti Polizia di Stato.
Rinnova prima della scadenza; non aspettare che il permesso sia scaduto.

items: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.

en: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.
it: Studenti UE che restano 3–12 mesi possono dover fare iscrizione nella popolazione temporanea, non un permesso.
Studenti extra-UE fino a 90 giorni possono dover fare dichiarazione di presenza secondo ingresso e alloggio.
Studenti in mobilita con permesso di altro Paese UE possono essere esenti dal permesso italiano solo se tutte le condizioni sono rispettate.
Se salti l’appuntamento in Questura, la pratica puo essere sospesa.
Se il primo soggiorno supera un anno, potrebbe servire firmare l’Accordo di Integrazione.

items: You and your family income/assets are in Italy: ordinary ISEE may be enough.
Your family income/assets are abroad: ISEE Parificato is commonly required.
You are independent from family: check the university/EDISU rules very carefully before assuming this.
You apply for EDISU scholarship: follow the current EDISU call.
You only need tuition reduction: follow your university fee rules.
If documents are foreign, check translation, legalization, apostille, and country-specific rules before paying.

en: You and your family income/assets are in Italy: ordinary ISEE may be enough.

it: Tu e redditi/patrimoni familiari siete in Italia: l’ISEE ordinario puo bastare.
Redditi/patrimoni familiari sono all’estero: spesso serve ISEE Parificato.
Ti consideri indipendente dalla famiglia: controlla bene regole universita/EDISU prima di darlo per scontato.
Fai domanda borsa EDISU: segui il bando EDISU attuale.
Ti serve solo riduzione tasse: segui le regole tasse del tuo ateneo.
Se i documenti sono esteri, controlla traduzione, legalizzazione, apostille e regole per Paese prima di pagare.

what_is_it.en: For renewal, Questura usually needs an official university certificate showing enrolment and exams. Self-certification may not be accepted for residence-permit renewal.
what_is_it.it: Per il rinnovo, la Questura di solito richiede un certificato universitario ufficiale con iscrizione ed esami. L’autocertificazione potrebbe non essere accettata per il rinnovo del permesso.
what_is_it.fr: For renewal, Questura usually needs an official university certificate showing enrolment and exams. Self-certification may not be accepted for residence-permit renewal.
what_is_it.es: For renewal, Questura usually needs an official university certificate showing enrolment and exams. Self-certification may not be accepted for residence-permit renewal.
what_is_it.fa: Per il rinnovo, la Questura di solito richiede un certificato universitario ufficiale con iscrizione ed esami. L’autocertificazione potrebbe non essere accettata per il rinnovo del permesso.
what_is_it.ar: For renewal, Questura usually needs an official university certificate showing enrolment and exams. Self-certification may not be accepted for residence-permit renewal.

how_to_do_it: Check the exact certificate requested by Questura or the university immigration page.
Download it from the student portal if available.
If not available, open a ticket to the student office.
Mention that it is for residence permit renewal.
Ask whether it must show exams, credits, and academic year.
Save the certificate as PDF and print a copy for the kit or Questura appointment.
If an exam is missing from the certificate, attach proof or ask office to update the record.

items: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.

en: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.
it: Primo rinnovo: almeno un esame superato.
Rinnovi successivi: almeno due esami per anno accademico.
Chiedi all’ufficio universitario se il tuo caso e speciale, per esempio dottorato, mobilita, anno solo tesi o corso senza esami ordinari.
La Questura puo chiedere documenti aggiuntivi in casi individuali.

items: Certificate of enrolment for the current academic year.

Stamp duty if the university requires it for official certificates.
Printed certificate if online certificate is not accepted for your case.
Clarification from student office if your exams are not visible yet.

items: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.

en: First renewal: at least one exam passed.
Later renewals: at least two exams per academic year.
Ask your university office if your case is special, such as PhD, mobility, thesis-only year, or programme without normal exams.
Questura can ask for extra documents in individual cases.
it: Primo rinnovo: almeno un esame superato.
Rinnovi successivi: almeno due esami per anno accademico.
Chiedi all’ufficio universitario se il tuo caso e speciale, per esempio dottorato, mobilita, anno solo tesi o corso senza esami ordinari.
La Questura puo chiedere documenti aggiuntivi in casi individuali.

items: Certificate of enrolment for the current academic year.
Certificate with exams passed and dates/credits if available.
Certificate in Italian if Questura requires Italian.
Stamp duty if the university requires it for official certificates.
Printed certificate if online certificate is not accepted for your case.
Clarification from student office if your exams are not visible yet.

en: Certificate of enrolment for the current academic year.
Certificate with exams passed and dates/credits if available.
Certificate in Italian if Questura requires Italian.
Stamp duty if the university requires it for official certificates.
Printed certificate if online certificate is not accepted for your case.
Clarification from student office if your exams are not visible yet.
it: Certificato di iscrizione all’anno accademico corrente.
Certificato con esami superati e date/crediti se disponibile.
Certificato in italiano se la Questura lo richiede.
Marca da bollo se l’universita la richiede per certificati ufficiali.
Certificato stampato se quello online non e accettato nel tuo caso.
Chiarimento dalla segreteria se gli esami non risultano ancora visibili.

items: Check the exact certificate requested by Questura or the university immigration page.
Download it from the student portal if available.
If not available, open a ticket to the student office.
Mention that it is for residence permit renewal.
Ask whether it must show exams, credits, and academic year.
Save the certificate as PDF and print a copy for the kit or Questura appointment.
If an exam is missing from the certificate, attach proof or ask office to update the record.

en: Check the exact certificate requested by Questura or the university immigration page.
Download it from the student portal if available.
If not available, open a ticket to the student office.
Mention that it is for residence permit renewal.
Ask whether it must show exams, credits, and academic year.
Save the certificate as PDF and print a copy for the kit or Questura appointment.
If an exam is missing from the certificate, attach proof or ask office to update the record.
it: Controlla il certificato esatto richiesto da Questura o pagina immigrazione universitaria.
Scaricalo dal portale studenti se disponibile.
Se non disponibile, apri ticket alla segreteria.
Scrivi che serve per rinnovo permesso di soggiorno.
Chiedi se deve mostrare esami, crediti e anno accademico.
Salva il certificato in PDF e stampa una copia per kit o appuntamento Questura.
Se manca un esame dal certificato, allega prova o chiedi aggiornamento carriera.

body.en: For student permits, you need health coverage. But coverage for permit paperwork is not always the same as real access to doctors, prescriptions, and public healthcare in Italy.

body.ar: For student permits, you need health coverage. But coverage for permit paperwork is not always the same as real access to doctors, prescriptions, and public healthcare in Italy.

items: Private insurance: may be enough for permesso, but check coverage limits and reimbursement rules.
Voluntary SSN registration: usually gives broader public healthcare access and lets you choose a family doctor.
EU students: may use European Health Insurance Card for necessary care, depending on situation.
Students who work regularly: may have mandatory SSN registration instead of voluntary student registration.
STP/ENI: only for special cases without ordinary SSN access, not normal student insurance.

en: Private insurance: may be enough for permesso, but check coverage limits and reimbursement rules.
Voluntary SSN registration: usually gives broader public healthcare access and lets you choose a family doctor.
EU students: may use European Health Insurance Card for necessary care, depending on situation.

it: Assicurazione privata: puo bastare per il permesso, ma controlla limiti e regole di rimborso.
Iscrizione volontaria SSN: di solito da accesso piu ampio alla sanita pubblica e permette di scegliere medico.
Studenti UE: possono usare TEAM/EHIC per cure necessarie, secondo il caso.
Studenti che lavorano regolarmente: possono rientrare nell’iscrizione obbligatoria SSN invece della volontaria.
STP/ENI: solo per casi speciali senza accesso ordinario SSN, non come normale assicurazione studenti.

Does it exclude pre-existing conditions, pregnancy, specialist visits, or medicines?
Does it need embassy/consulate endorsement if bought abroad?

items: Private insurance: may be enough for permesso, but check coverage limits and reimbursement rules.
Voluntary SSN registration: usually gives broader public healthcare access and lets you choose a family doctor.
EU students: may use European Health Insurance Card for necessary care, depending on situation.
Students who work regularly: may have mandatory SSN registration instead of voluntary student registration.
STP/ENI: only for special cases without ordinary SSN access, not normal student insurance.

en: Private insurance: may be enough for permesso, but check coverage limits and reimbursement rules.
Voluntary SSN registration: usually gives broader public healthcare access and lets you choose a family doctor.

it: Assicurazione privata: puo bastare per il permesso, ma controlla limiti e regole di rimborso.
Iscrizione volontaria SSN: di solito da accesso piu ampio alla sanita pubblica e permette di scegliere medico.
Studenti UE: possono usare TEAM/EHIC per cure necessarie, secondo il caso.
Studenti che lavorano regolarmente: possono rientrare nell’iscrizione obbligatoria SSN invece della volontaria.
STP/ENI: solo per casi speciali senza accesso ordinario SSN, non come normale assicurazione studenti.

items: Ask: who issued the document or bill?
Ask: who rejected the request?
Ask: who can change the official record?
Ask: is this a public-office issue, contract issue, payment issue, or legal dispute?
If there is a protocol number, start from the office that issued it.
If money was charged by a company, start from that company’s complaint channel.
If there is a deadline or legal paper, do not wait for informal replies.
If unsure, send a short information request before sending a full formal complaint.

en: Ask: who issued the document or bill?
Ask: who rejected the request?
Ask: who can change the official record?
Ask: is this a public-office issue, contract issue, payment issue, or legal dispute?
If there is a protocol number, start from the office that issued it.
If money was charged by a company, start from that company’s complaint channel.
If there is a deadline or legal paper, do not wait for informal replies.
If unsure, send a short information request before sending a full formal complaint.
it: Chiediti: chi ha emesso il documento o la bolletta?
Chiediti: chi ha respinto la richiesta?
Chiediti: chi può modificare il dato ufficiale?
Chiediti: è un problema di ufficio pubblico, contratto, pagamento o vertenza legale?
Se c’è un protocollo, parti dall’ufficio che lo ha emesso.
Se il costo è stato addebitato da un’azienda, parti dal canale reclami dell’azienda.
Se c’è una scadenza o un atto legale, non aspettare risposte informali.
Se hai dubbi, invia una richiesta breve di informazioni prima del reclamo completo.

body.en: Sending a formal message to the wrong office wastes time. First identify who can actually fix the record, refund the money, reopen the request, or answer the complaint.

items: Ask: who issued the document or bill?
Ask: who rejected the request?
Ask: who can change the official record?
Ask: is this a public-office issue, contract issue, payment issue, or legal dispute?
If there is a protocol number, start from the office that issued it.
If money was charged by a company, start from that company’s complaint channel.
If there is a deadline or legal paper, do not wait for informal replies.
If unsure, send a short information request before sending a full formal complaint.

en: Ask: who issued the document or bill?
Ask: who rejected the request?
Ask: who can change the official record?
Ask: is this a public-office issue, contract issue, payment issue, or legal dispute?
If there is a protocol number, start from the office that issued it.
If money was charged by a company, start from that company’s complaint channel.
If there is a deadline or legal paper, do not wait for informal replies.
If unsure, send a short information request before sending a full formal complaint.
it: Chiediti: chi ha emesso il documento o la bolletta?
Chiediti: chi ha respinto la richiesta?
Chiediti: chi può modificare il dato ufficiale?
Chiediti: è un problema di ufficio pubblico, contratto, pagamento o vertenza legale?
Se c’è un protocollo, parti dall’ufficio che lo ha emesso.
Se il costo è stato addebitato da un’azienda, parti dal canale reclami dell’azienda.
Se c’è una scadenza o un atto legale, non aspettare risposte informali.
Se hai dubbi, invia una richiesta breve di informazioni prima del reclamo completo.

items: Low ISEE + bills: check bonus sociale for electricity, gas, water, and waste.
Children: check Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido, Bonus nuovi nati, and school benefits.
Rent difficulty: check Regione/Comune rent support and emergency housing paths.
University student: check EDISU, tuition reduction, ISEE/ISEE Parificato, and rental proof.
School-age child in Piemonte: check Voucher scuola Piemonte.
Disability or serious health condition: check ADI, disability-linked INPS benefits, bonus sociale disagio fisico, and local support.
Unemployed or fragile household: check NASpI, ADI, SFL, Comune social services, and patronato.
Psychological support: check Bonus psicologo only when the INPS application window is open.
Automatic benefits: check that ISEE, household, IBAN, and contract-holder data are correct.

it: ISEE basso + bollette: controlla bonus sociale luce, gas, acqua e rifiuti.
Figli: controlla Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido, Bonus nuovi nati e benefici scuola.
Difficoltà affitto: controlla sostegno affitto Regione/Comune ed emergenza abitativa.

Figlio a scuola in Piemonte: controlla Voucher scuola Piemonte.
Disabilità o grave condizione sanitaria: controlla ADI, benefici INPS legati a disabilità, bonus sociale disagio fisico e supporti locali.
Disoccupazione o nucleo fragile: controlla NASpI, ADI, SFL, servizi sociali Comune e patronato.
Supporto psicologico: controlla Bonus psicologo solo quando INPS apre la finestra domanda.
Bonus automatici: controlla che ISEE, nucleo, IBAN e intestatario contratto siano corretti.

items: Likely relevant: conditions look close, verify the official page.
Maybe relevant: one or more key details are missing.
Not for you: the benefit is for a different group.
Automatic: no normal application, but data must be correct.
Seasonal: exists, but the application window may be closed.
Local: depends on Regione or Comune, not only national rules.
Needs CAF or patronato: do not try alone if documents are complex.
Needs official confirmation: rules changed recently or the case is unusual.

items: Ordinary ISEE: general benefits and many local supports.
ISEE Minorenni: often needed when benefits are for a minor child, especially when parents are not married/not living together.
ISEE Universitario: university fees and student benefits for Italian-based households.
ISEE Parificato: often used by foreign students with family income/assets abroad.
Current ISEE: used when income, work, or household situation changed significantly.
2026 ISEE for family and inclusion benefits: used for ADI, SFL, Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido, and Bonus nuovi nati.

en: Ordinary ISEE: general benefits and many local supports.
ISEE Minorenni: often needed when benefits are for a minor child, especially when parents are not married/not living together.
ISEE Universitario: university fees and student benefits for Italian-based households.
ISEE Parificato: often used by foreign students with family income/assets abroad.
Current ISEE: used when income, work, or household situation changed significantly.

it: ISEE ordinario: benefici generali e molti sostegni locali.
ISEE minorenni: spesso necessario per benefici rivolti a figli minorenni, soprattutto con genitori non coniugati/non conviventi.
ISEE universitario: tasse universitarie e benefici studenti per nuclei in Italia.
ISEE parificato: spesso usato da studenti stranieri con redditi/patrimoni familiari all’estero.
ISEE corrente: usato quando reddito, lavoro o nucleo sono cambiati molto.
ISEE 2026 per prestazioni familiari e inclusione: usato per ADI, SFL, Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido e Bonus nuovi nati.

items: CAF: safest when documents are many or foreign.
INPS pre-filled ISEE portal: useful if you can manage it online.

Patronato is usually for INPS benefits, while CAF is usually for ISEE/tax documents.

items: Submit DSU and get a valid ISEE.
Make sure the bill is in the name of someone in the ISEE household.
Make sure the supply is domestic/residential when required.
The discount is normally applied automatically if the data matches.
If the bill is in the landlord’s name, the direct bonus may not appear.
Check later bills and ask supplier/CAF/Sportello if the discount is missing.
Keep ISEE receipt and bills.

en: Submit DSU and get a valid ISEE.
Make sure the bill is in the name of someone in the ISEE household.
Make sure the supply is domestic/residential when required.
The discount is normally applied automatically if the data matches.
If the bill is in the landlord’s name, the direct bonus may not appear.
Check later bills and ask supplier/CAF/Sportello if the discount is missing.
Keep ISEE receipt and bills.
it: Presenta DSU e ottieni ISEE valido.
Assicurati che la bolletta sia intestata a un componente del nucleo ISEE.
Assicurati che la fornitura sia domestica/residenziale quando richiesto.
Lo sconto di solito viene applicato automaticamente se i dati coincidono.
Se la bolletta è intestata al proprietario, il bonus diretto potrebbe non comparire.
Controlla le bollette successive e chiedi a fornitore/CAF/Sportello se lo sconto manca.
Conserva ricevuta ISEE e bollette.

items: Check if your previous application is accepted.
Submit DSU for 2026 ISEE.
Update family situation if children, custody, IBAN, residence or household changed.
Check if the child turned 18 and extra conditions are needed.
Submit DSU by 30 June if you want arrears from March.
Check INPS messages and payment status.
Use patronato if custody, separation, disability, foreign documents or IBAN issues make the case complex.

en: Check if your previous application is accepted.

Update family situation if children, custody, IBAN, residence or household changed.
Check if the child turned 18 and extra conditions are needed.

it: Controlla se la domanda precedente è accolta.
Presenta DSU per ISEE 2026.
Aggiorna la situazione se sono cambiati figli, affidamento, IBAN, residenza o nucleo.
Controlla se il figlio ha compiuto 18 anni e servono condizioni aggiuntive.
Presenta DSU entro 30 giugno se vuoi arretrati da marzo.
Controlla messaggi INPS e stato pagamenti.
Usa patronato se affidamento, separazione, disabilità, documenti esteri o IBAN rendono il caso complesso.

items: Do not look for a normal application form.
Check Comune communications and beneficiary lists.
Check that your ISEE and household data are up to date.
If selected, follow instructions for Poste card pick-up or use of previous card.
Bring card identification number and identity document when requested.
If already received the card in a previous year, check whether the amount is loaded on the same card.
If you think you were wrongly excluded, contact Comune or CAF, not Poste first.

en: Do not look for a normal application form.
Check Comune communications and beneficiary lists.
Check that your ISEE and household data are up to date.
If selected, follow instructions for Poste card pick-up or use of previous card.
Bring card identification number and identity document when requested.
If already received the card in a previous year, check whether the amount is loaded on the same card.
If you think you were wrongly excluded, contact Comune or CAF, not Poste first.
it: Non cercare un modulo di domanda normale.
Controlla comunicazioni e liste del Comune.
Verifica che ISEE e dati del nucleo siano aggiornati.
Se selezionato, segui istruzioni per ritiro carta Poste o uso della carta precedente.
Porta numero identificativo carta e documento quando richiesto.
Se hai già ricevuto la carta in un anno precedente, controlla se l’importo viene caricato sulla stessa carta.
Se pensi di essere stato escluso per errore, contatta Comune o CAF, non prima Poste.

body.en: INPS says the card can be collected by the holder or by a formally delegated person with legal authorization such as procura or appointment by a judge.
body.it: INPS indica che la carta può essere ritirata dall’intestatario o da un delegato formale con titolo giuridico, come procura o nomina del giudice tutelare.
body.fr: INPS says the card can be collected by the holder or by a formally delegated person with legal authorization such as procura or appointment by a judge.
body.es: INPS says the card can be collected by the holder or by a formally delegated person with legal authorization such as procura or appointment by a judge.
body.fa: INPS indica che la carta può essere ritirata dall’intestatario o da un delegato formale con titolo giuridico, come procura o nomina del giudice tutelare.
body.ar: INPS says the card can be collected by the holder or by a formally delegated person with legal authorization such as procura or appointment by a judge.

body.en: Eligibility depends on current rules, ISEE, residence, family status and application windows. Always verify the official page before applying.
body.it: L’idoneità dipende da regole attuali, ISEE, residenza, situazione familiare e finestre di domanda. Verifica sempre la pagina ufficiale prima di fare domanda.
body.fr: L’éligibilité dépend des règles en vigueur, de l’ISEE, de la résidence, de la situation familiale et des périodes d’ouverture. Vérifiez toujours la page officielle avant de demander.
body.es: La elegibilidad depende de las reglas actuales, el ISEE, la residencia, la situación familiar y las ventanas de solicitud. Verifica siempre la página oficial antes de solicitar.
body.fa: واجد شرایط بودن به قوانین فعلی، ISEE، محل اقامت، وضعیت خانوادگی و بازه درخواست بستگی دارد. همیشه قبل از اقدام صفحه رسمی را بررسی کن.
body.ar: تعتمد الأهلية على القواعد الحالية وISEE والإقامة والوضع العائلي وفترات التقديم. تحقق دائماً من الصفحة الرسمية قبل التقديم.

body.en: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.it: Un contributo, un prestito, una garanzia pubblica e una sospensione rate risolvono problemi diversi. Se li confondi, puoi firmare un debito quando ti serviva un beneficio, oppure aspettarti soldi gratuiti da qualcosa che va restituito.
body.fr: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.es: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.fa: Un contributo, un prestito, una garanzia pubblica e una sospensione rate risolvono problemi diversi. Se li confondi, puoi firmare un debito quando ti serviva un beneficio, oppure aspettarti soldi gratuiti da qualcosa che va restituito.
body.ar: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.

items: Grant or bonus: money/support you usually do not repay, if you meet the rules.
Loan: money you borrow and must repay, usually with interest and fees.
Credit line: money you can use up to a limit, then repay later.
Public guarantee: the State helps the bank reduce risk, but you still owe the bank.
Mortgage suspension: temporary pause in payments, not cancellation of the debt.
Personal loan: credit for personal needs, with instalments and total cost.
Student honor loan: usually a credit line during study, then repayment starts later.
Payment plan: divides a debt into instalments; it does not erase the debt.

en: Grant or bonus: money/support you usually do not repay, if you meet the rules.
Loan: money you borrow and must repay, usually with interest and fees.
Credit line: money you can use up to a limit, then repay later.
Public guarantee: the State helps the bank reduce risk, but you still owe the bank.
Mortgage suspension: temporary pause in payments, not cancellation of the debt.
Personal loan: credit for personal needs, with instalments and total cost.
Student honor loan: usually a credit line during study, then repayment starts later.
Payment plan: divides a debt into instalments; it does not erase the debt.
it: Contributo o bonus: soldi/supporto che di solito non devi restituire, se rispetti le regole.
Prestito: soldi che prendi in prestito e devi restituire, spesso con interessi e spese.
Linea di credito: importo che puoi usare entro un limite e rimborsare dopo.
Garanzia pubblica: lo Stato aiuta la banca a ridurre il rischio, ma il debito resta tuo.
Sospensione mutuo: pausa temporanea delle rate, non cancellazione del debito.
Prestito personale: credito per esigenze personali, con rate e costo totale.
Prestito d’onore studenti: spesso linea di credito durante lo studio, poi rimborso successivo.
Piano di rientro: divide un debito in rate; non cancella il debito.

items: Check if a grant, bonus, scholarship or public support exists first.
Check if you can delay, reduce, or split the payment without taking a loan.
Calculate total amount to repay, not only the monthly instalment.
Check TAEG, not only TAN.
Check whether insurance is optional or required.
Check late-payment consequences.
Check early-repayment rules.
Ask what happens if your income drops.
Do not sign under pressure or during a phone call without written documents.

it: Controlla prima se esiste contributo, bonus, borsa o sostegno pubblico.

Calcola l’importo totale da restituire, non solo la rata mensile.
Controlla il TAEG, non solo il TAN.
Verifica se l’assicurazione è facoltativa o obbligatoria.
Controlla le conseguenze dei ritardi.
Controlla le regole di rimborso anticipato.
Chiedi cosa succede se il reddito diminuisce.
Non firmare sotto pressione o al telefono senza documenti scritti.

items: For students aged 18 to 40.
For merit-based study paths listed by the Fund.
Can cover university, master, specialisation school, PhD, language courses and ITS Academy paths where eligible.
Managed through MyConsap and participating banks.
Annual tranches up to €15,000 for each remaining study year.

it: Per studenti tra 18 e 40 anni.
Per percorsi di studio meritevoli previsti dal Fondo.
Può coprire università, master, scuola di specializzazione, dottorato, corsi di lingua e ITS Academy quando ammessi.
Gestito tramite MyConsap e banche aderenti.
Tranche annuali fino a 15.000 € per ogni anno residuo di corso.
Massimo 50.000 €, o fino a 70.000 € per studio all’estero.
Le tranche successive dipendono dall’iscrizione agli anni successivi e dai requisiti di merito/progresso.
Rimborso da 3 a 15 anni.
Il rimborso non può iniziare prima del 30° mese dall’ultima tranche.
Le banche non dovrebbero chiedere garanzie aggiuntive oltre alla garanzia statale.

body.en: UniCredit Ad Honorem is an honor loan linked to partner universities or entities. It starts as a current-account credit line and later becomes a personal loan.
body.it: UniCredit Ad Honorem è un prestito d’onore collegato a università o enti convenzionati. Parte come linea di credito in conto corrente e poi diventa prestito personale.
body.fr: UniCredit Ad Honorem is an honor loan linked to partner universities or entities. It starts as a current-account credit line and later becomes a personal loan.
body.es: UniCredit Ad Honorem is an honor loan linked to partner universities or entities. It starts as a current-account credit line and later becomes a personal loan.
body.fa: UniCredit Ad Honorem è un prestito d’onore collegato a università o enti convenzionati. Parte come linea di credito in conto corrente e poi diventa prestito personale.
body.ar: UniCredit Ad Honorem is an honor loan linked to partner universities or entities. It starts as a current-account credit line and later becomes a personal loan.

items: For university students linked to partner institutions.
For EU and non-EU citizens resident in Italy.
Credit line up to €27,700.
At the end of studies, the amount used plus interest becomes a personal loan.
Possible grace period up to 2 years after study cycle.
During the grace period, no additional interest accrues according to the provider page.
Repayment from 12 to 180 months.
Bank evaluates requirements and creditworthiness.
TAEG and full conditions are in the official consumer credit information sheet.

en: For university students linked to partner institutions.
For EU and non-EU citizens resident in Italy.
Credit line up to €27,700.
At the end of studies, the amount used plus interest becomes a personal loan.
Possible grace period up to 2 years after study cycle.
During the grace period, no additional interest accrues according to the provider page.
Repayment from 12 to 180 months.
Bank evaluates requirements and creditworthiness.
TAEG and full conditions are in the official consumer credit information sheet.
it: Per studenti universitari collegati a enti convenzionati.
Per cittadini UE ed extra-UE residenti in Italia.
Linea di credito fino a 27.700 €.
Alla fine degli studi, l’importo usato più interessi diventa prestito personale.
Possibile periodo di grazia fino a 2 anni dopo il ciclo di studi.
Durante il periodo di grazia non maturano ulteriori interessi secondo la pagina del fornitore.
Rimborso da 12 a 180 mesi.
La banca valuta requisiti e merito creditizio.
TAEG e condizioni complete sono nel modulo informazioni europee di base sul credito ai consumatori.

items: Focused on post-university master programmes.

en: Focused on post-university master programmes.
Can cover master cost and up to 10% for food and housing expenses.

it: Pensato per master post-universitari.
Può coprire costo del master e fino al 10% per vitto e alloggio.
Il rimborso può iniziare da 24 mesi dopo la fine del master.
Rimborso fino a 120 rate mensili.
Condizioni dipendono da valutazione banca e convenzioni.
Chiedi il foglio informativo ufficiale prima di firmare.

body.en: A delayed repayment start is useful only if you expect stable income later. Check the total amount you will repay after the grace period.
body.it: L’avvio ritardato del rimborso è utile solo se prevedi reddito stabile dopo. Controlla l’importo totale da restituire dopo il periodo di attesa.

body.en: This is credit, not free money. Compare TAEG, total cost, repayment duration, guarantees and late-payment consequences before signing.
body.it: Questo è credito, non denaro gratuito. Confronta TAEG, costo totale, durata del rimborso, garanzie e conseguenze dei ritardi prima di firmare.
body.fr: Il s’agit d’un crédit, pas d’argent gratuit. Comparez TAEG, coût total, durée de remboursement, garanties et conséquences des retards avant de signer.
body.es: Esto es crédito, no dinero gratis. Compara TAEG, coste total, duración del pago, garantías y consecuencias del retraso antes de firmar.
body.fa: این اعتبار است، نه پول رایگان. پیش از امضا TAEG، هزینه کل، مدت بازپرداخت، ضمانت‌ها و پیامد تأخیر را مقایسه کن.
body.ar: هذا ائتمان وليس مالاً مجانياً. قارن TAEG والتكلفة الإجمالية ومدة السداد والضمانات وعواقب التأخير قبل التوقيع.

items: You must apply through a participating bank.
Mortgage amount must not exceed €250,000.
Public guarantee is generally 50%.
You normally must not own other residential property, including abroad, with limited inheritance exceptions.

Bank still evaluates whether to give the mortgage.
The guarantee reduces bank risk, not your debt.

en: You must apply through a participating bank.

it: La domanda passa tramite una banca aderente.
Il mutuo non deve superare 250.000 €.
La garanzia pubblica è generalmente del 50%.

La banca valuta comunque se concedere il mutuo.
La garanzia riduce il rischio della banca, non il tuo debito.

body.en: Italian bureaucracy becomes easier when you know which office owns each problem. Sending the right request to the wrong office wastes time and can make deadlines harder.
body.it: La burocrazia italiana diventa più semplice quando sai quale ufficio gestisce ogni problema. Inviare la richiesta giusta all’ufficio sbagliato fa perdere tempo e può complicare le scadenze.

items: Questura: permesso di soggiorno, fingerprints, police appointments, permit collection.
Poste Sportello Amico: yellow kit collection and submission for many permit types.
Comune / Anagrafe: residence, address change, CIE identity card, certificates, family status, temporary population register.
Agenzia Entrate: codice fiscale, tax-code certificate, tax office issues.
ASL: healthcare registration, family doctor, health card position, exemptions.
CAF: ISEE, tax declarations, some bonus applications, income paperwork.
Patronato: INPS, NASpI, pensions, social security and many welfare applications.
University or EDISU: student enrollment, scholarship, university housing, student-specific certificates.
Poste Italiane: registered mail, postal kit receipt, some payment slips and appointment services.

items: If you are non-EU: check visa, permit kit deadline, and Questura/Poste path first.
Get or verify codice fiscale because almost every other office needs it.
Secure housing proof: rental contract, hospitality declaration, or residence/domicile proof.
Start residence only when you actually live at the address.
Prepare name on doorbell and mailbox before residence checks.
Set up SPID/CIE/PEC as soon as documents allow it.
Use ASL only for healthcare, not for residence or permit issues.
Keep every receipt, protocol number, appointment slip, and screenshot.

it: Se sei extra-UE: controlla prima visto, scadenza kit permesso e percorso Questura/Poste.

Metti in ordine la prova dell’alloggio: contratto, ospitalità o prova di residenza/domicilio.

Attiva SPID/CIE/PEC appena i documenti lo permettono.
Usa ASL solo per sanità, non per residenza o permesso.
Conserva ogni ricevuta, protocollo, convocazione e screenshot.

body.en: Work problems in Italy split between different offices. If you ask the wrong place, you lose time. INPS handles benefits, but unpaid salary or a bad contract is usually not solved by INPS.

body.en: NASpI is the monthly unemployment benefit for employees who lost their job involuntarily and meet the INPS requirements.
body.it: La NASpI è l’indennità mensile di disoccupazione per lavoratori dipendenti che hanno perso il lavoro involontariamente e rispettano i requisiti INPS.
body.fr: NASpI is the monthly unemployment benefit for employees who lost their job involuntarily and meet the INPS requirements.
body.es: NASpI is the monthly unemployment benefit for employees who lost their job involuntarily and meet the INPS requirements.

body.en: INPS says the application must be sent within 68 days from the end of the employment relationship and only after the work relationship has ended. If you apply within the first eight days, NASpI can start from the eighth day after the end of work; otherwise it normally starts from the day after the application.
body.it: INPS indica che la domanda deve essere inviata entro 68 giorni dalla cessazione del rapporto e solo dopo la fine del rapporto di lavoro. Se invii entro i primi otto giorni, la NASpI può decorrere dall’ottavo giorno dopo la cessazione; altrimenti di solito decorre dal giorno successivo alla domanda.

items: EU students staying 3–12 months may need temporary population registration, not a permesso.
Non-EU students staying up to 90 days may need declaration of presence depending on entry route and accommodation.
Mobility students with a residence permit from another EU country may be exempt from Italian permit only if all conditions are met.
If you miss the Questura appointment, the application can be suspended.
If your stay exceeds one year at first permit, you may need to sign the Integration Agreement.

it: Studenti UE che restano 3–12 mesi possono dover fare iscrizione nella popolazione temporanea, non un permesso.

Studenti in mobilita con permesso di altro Paese UE possono essere esenti dal permesso italiano solo se tutte le condizioni sono rispettate.
Se salti l’appuntamento in Questura, la pratica puo essere sospesa.
Se il primo soggiorno supera un anno, potrebbe servire firmare l’Accordo di Integrazione.

body.en: For student permits, you need health coverage. But coverage for permit paperwork is not always the same as real access to doctors, prescriptions, and public healthcare in Italy.
body.it: Per il permesso studenti serve copertura sanitaria. Ma la copertura accettata per il permesso non sempre coincide con accesso reale a medici, ricette e sanita pubblica in Italia.

body.ar: For student permits, you need health coverage. But coverage for permit paperwork is not always the same as real access to doctors, prescriptions, and public healthcare in Italy.

items: Private insurance: may be enough for permesso, but check coverage limits and reimbursement rules.
Voluntary SSN registration: usually gives broader public healthcare access and lets you choose a family doctor.
EU students: may use European Health Insurance Card for necessary care, depending on situation.
Students who work regularly: may have mandatory SSN registration instead of voluntary student registration.
STP/ENI: only for special cases without ordinary SSN access, not normal student insurance.

STP/ENI: solo per casi speciali senza accesso ordinario SSN, non come normale assicurazione studenti.

items: Ask: who issued the document or bill?
Ask: who rejected the request?
Ask: who can change the official record?
Ask: is this a public-office issue, contract issue, payment issue, or legal dispute?
If there is a protocol number, start from the office that issued it.
If money was charged by a company, start from that company’s complaint channel.
If there is a deadline or legal paper, do not wait for informal replies.
If unsure, send a short information request before sending a full formal complaint.

items: Ordinary ISEE: general benefits and many local supports.
ISEE Minorenni: often needed when benefits are for a minor child, especially when parents are not married/not living together.
ISEE Universitario: university fees and student benefits for Italian-based households.
ISEE Parificato: often used by foreign students with family income/assets abroad.
Current ISEE: used when income, work, or household situation changed significantly.
2026 ISEE for family and inclusion benefits: used for ADI, SFL, Assegno Unico, Bonus asilo nido, and Bonus nuovi nati.

body.en: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.it: Un contributo, un prestito, una garanzia pubblica e una sospensione rate risolvono problemi diversi. Se li confondi, puoi firmare un debito quando ti serviva un beneficio, oppure aspettarti soldi gratuiti da qualcosa che va restituito.
body.fr: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.
body.es: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.

body.ar: A grant, a loan, a public guarantee and a payment suspension solve different problems. If you confuse them, you may sign a debt when you only needed a benefit, or expect free money from something that must be repaid.

items: Grant or bonus: money/support you usually do not repay, if you meet the rules.
Loan: money you borrow and must repay, usually with interest and fees.
Credit line: money you can use up to a limit, then repay later.
Public guarantee: the State helps the bank reduce risk, but you still owe the bank.
Mortgage suspension: temporary pause in payments, not cancellation of the debt.
Personal loan: credit for personal needs, with instalments and total cost.
Student honor loan: usually a credit line during study, then repayment starts later.
Payment plan: divides a debt into instalments; it does not erase the debt.

it: Contributo o bonus: soldi/supporto che di solito non devi restituire, se rispetti le regole.
Prestito: soldi che prendi in prestito e devi restituire, spesso con interessi e spese.
Linea di credito: importo che puoi usare entro un limite e rimborsare dopo.
Garanzia pubblica: lo Stato aiuta la banca a ridurre il rischio, ma il debito resta tuo.
Sospensione mutuo: pausa temporanea delle rate, non cancellazione del debito.
Prestito personale: credito per esigenze personali, con rate e costo totale.
Prestito d’onore studenti: spesso linea di credito durante lo studio, poi rimborso successivo.
Piano di rientro: divide un debito in rate; non cancella il debito.

body.en: Fondo Studio is a State-guaranteed credit fund for students. Consap checks fund requirements; the bank still evaluates credit and decides whether to finance.
body.it: Fondo Studio è un fondo di credito garantito dallo Stato per studenti. Consap verifica i requisiti del Fondo; la banca valuta comunque il merito creditizio e decide se finanziare.
body.fr: Fondo Studio is a State-guaranteed credit fund for students. Consap checks fund requirements; the bank still evaluates credit and decides whether to finance.
body.es: Fondo Studio is a State-guaranteed credit fund for students. Consap checks fund requirements; the bank still evaluates credit and decides whether to finance.
body.fa: Fondo Studio è un fondo di credito garantito dallo Stato per studenti. Consap verifica i requisiti del Fondo; la banca valuta comunque il merito creditizio e decide se finanziare.
body.ar: Fondo Studio is a State-guaranteed credit fund for students. Consap checks fund requirements; the bank still evaluates credit and decides whether to finance.

items: For students aged 18 to 40.
For merit-based study paths listed by the Fund.
Can cover university, master, specialisation school, PhD, language courses and ITS Academy paths where eligible.
Managed through MyConsap and participating banks.
Annual tranches up to €15,000 for each remaining study year.
Maximum €50,000, or up to €70,000 for study abroad.
Later tranches depend on enrolment in later years and merit/progress requirements.
Repayment can be from 3 to 15 years.
Repayment cannot start before the 30th month after the last tranche.
Banks should not ask for extra guarantees beyond the State guarantee.

Tranche annuali fino a 15.000 € per ogni anno residuo di corso.

items: You must apply through a participating bank.
Mortgage amount must not exceed €250,000.
Public guarantee is generally 50%.
You normally must not own other residential property, including abroad, with limited inheritance exceptions.
The property must be used as first home and must meet Fund rules.
Bank still evaluates whether to give the mortgage.
The guarantee reduces bank risk, not your debt.

description.it: Iscrizione SSN, casi lavoro e studio, assistenza temporanea, STP ed ENI.

shortDescription.en: Use this if you live in Torino and need ordinary access to the public health system.
shortDescription.it: Usa questa guida se vivi a Torino e ti serve l'accesso ordinario alla sanita pubblica.

body.en: You have the right to SSN because of residence, work, family reunification, long-term stay, asylum, or another eligible status and you need Torino ASL to register you correctly.
body.it: Hai diritto al SSN per residenza, lavoro, ricongiungimento, soggiorno di lungo periodo, asilo o altro titolo valido e devi farti registrare correttamente dall'ASL di Torino.

body.en: You only need temporary urgent care, you are waiting for the correct permit, or you need STP/ENI. In those cases start from the dedicated foreigner route below.
body.it: Ti serve solo assistenza temporanea urgente, stai aspettando il permesso giusto o devi usare STP/ENI. In quei casi parti dal percorso stranieri dedicato qui sotto.

en: Passport or identity card.
Codice fiscale.
Proof of address in Torino: residence certificate, rental contract, hospitality declaration, or another address document.
Document that proves why you can register: permit, work contract, UNILAV, family document, or enrollment proof.
Any old Tessera Sanitaria, ASL receipt, rejection letter, or protocol number.
it: Passaporto o carta di identita.
Codice fiscale.
Prova dell'indirizzo a Torino: residenza, contratto di affitto, dichiarazione di ospitalita o altro documento dell'indirizzo.
Documento che prova il diritto all'iscrizione: permesso, contratto di lavoro, UNILAV, documento familiare o prova di iscrizione.
Eventuale vecchia Tessera Sanitaria, ricevuta ASL, rifiuto scritto o numero di protocollo.

en: Check first if your case is ordinary SSN registration or a foreigner/student/temporary route.
If your documents are straightforward, verify whether the regional service can handle it online.
If the case is foreign, document-heavy, or already refused, go to the ASL administrative counter for your district.
Ask for SSN registration first. Only after that choose your family doctor or pediatrician.
it: Controlla prima se il tuo caso e un'iscrizione SSN ordinaria oppure un percorso stranieri/studenti/temporaneo.
Se i documenti sono semplici, verifica se il servizio regionale lo gestisce online.
Se il caso riguarda stranieri, molti documenti o un rifiuto gia ricevuto, vai allo sportello amministrativo ASL del tuo distretto.
Chiedi prima l'iscrizione al SSN. Solo dopo scegli medico di base o pediatra.

body.en: Ordinary SSN registration itself is not a separate service fee. The real cost depends on your legal status only if the law puts you in a voluntary registration route.
body.it: L'iscrizione ordinaria al SSN non ha un costo di servizio separato. Il costo reale dipende dal tuo status solo se la legge ti mette nell'iscrizione volontaria.

body.en: Ask for the exact reason in writing, the missing document list, and the office protocol number. If the refusal is generic, write to URP or PEC and attach your documents plus the refusal note.
body.it: Chiedi il motivo preciso per iscritto, l'elenco dei documenti mancanti e il numero di protocollo dell'ufficio. Se il rifiuto e generico, scrivi a URP o PEC allegando documenti e nota di rifiuto.

body.en: You have a work-based permit, subordinate or self-employed activity, or another foreigner status that gives mandatory SSN registration through work in Italy.

en: Passport.
Codice fiscale.

Address document in Torino.

Permesso di soggiorno o ricevuta di rinnovo.
Contratto di lavoro, UNILAV, ultima busta paga o dichiarazione del datore.
Documento dell'indirizzo a Torino.

body.en: Do not pay voluntary SSN just because you are non-EU. If your permit gives mandatory registration, ask ASL to register you on that basis.
body.it: Non pagare il SSN volontario solo perche sei extra-UE. Se il tuo permesso da iscrizione obbligatoria, chiedi all'ASL di registrarti su quella base.

shortDescription.en: Use this if you live in Torino but your official residence is elsewhere and you need care here for a limited period.
shortDescription.it: Usa questa guida se vivi a Torino ma la tua residenza e altrove e ti serve assistenza qui per un periodo limitato.

body.en: You are domiciled in Torino for study, work, or another temporary reason and you need a doctor or healthcare access here without moving your official residence.
body.it: Sei domiciliato a Torino per studio, lavoro o altro motivo temporaneo e ti serve un medico o l'accesso sanitario qui senza spostare la residenza ufficiale.

en: Identity document and codice fiscale.
Proof of residence elsewhere in Italy.
Proof that you actually live in Torino now: rental contract, university housing, hospitality declaration, or employer note.
Document that explains why you are in Torino: university enrollment, work contract, internship, or similar.
it: Documento e codice fiscale.
Prova della residenza in un altro Comune italiano.
Prova che vivi davvero a Torino adesso: contratto di affitto, alloggio universitario, dichiarazione di ospitalita o nota del datore.
Documento che spiega perche sei a Torino: iscrizione universitaria, contratto di lavoro, tirocinio o simili.

en: Check first whether the doctor-choice service can already handle your temporary domicile case online.
If not, go to the ASL administrative counter with both residence and Torino domicile documents.
Ask for temporary healthcare assistance or the route that lets you choose a doctor in Torino for the period you stay here.
it: Controlla prima se il servizio scelta medico gestisce gia online il tuo caso di domicilio temporaneo.
Se non basta, vai allo sportello amministrativo ASL con documenti di residenza e domicilio torinese.
Chiedi l'assistenza sanitaria temporanea o il percorso che ti permette di scegliere un medico a Torino per il periodo in cui resti qui.

body.en: Arriving with only a university badge or a verbal address is usually not enough. Torino ASL usually wants real address evidence plus the reason why you are staying here.
body.it: Presentarsi solo con badge universitario o indirizzo detto a voce di solito non basta. L'ASL di Torino vuole una prova reale dell'indirizzo e del motivo per cui sei qui.

shortDescription.it: Usa questa guida se non hai l'iscrizione ordinaria al SSN e hai bisogno di assistenza sanitaria come cittadino straniero a Torino.

body.en: You are a non-EU person without regular SSN registration, or an EU citizen without ordinary coverage, and you need access through STP, ENI, or the ISI service.
body.it: Sei una persona extra-UE senza iscrizione regolare al SSN, oppure un cittadino UE senza copertura ordinaria, e devi accedere tramite STP, ENI o servizio ISI.

en: Passport or any identity document you have.
Any expired permit, renewal receipt, hospital note, or previous STP/ENI code.
Address or hospitality information if available.
it: Passaporto o qualsiasi documento di identita disponibile.
Eventuale permesso scaduto, ricevuta di rinnovo, foglio ospedaliero o vecchio codice STP/ENI.
Indirizzo o informazioni di ospitalita se disponibili.

body.en: Urgent or essential care, continuity of care, pregnancy protection, vaccinations, and other services allowed by the foreigner-health rules. It is not the same as full ordinary SSN registration.
body.it: Cure urgenti o essenziali, continuita terapeutica, tutela della gravidanza, vaccinazioni e altri servizi previsti dalle regole per l'assistenza agli stranieri. Non e la stessa cosa dell'iscrizione ordinaria completa al SSN.

body.en: Do not wait until the problem becomes urgent. If your permit situation is unstable or your ordinary SSN route is blocked, ask Centro ISI early.
body.it: Non aspettare che il problema diventi urgente. Se la tua situazione di permesso e instabile o il percorso SSN ordinario si blocca, senti il Centro ISI subito.

shortDescription.it: Usa questa guida se sei gia nel SSN e devi scegliere, cambiare o revocare il medico di base a Torino.

body.en: You already have ordinary SSN registration and need a new GP because you moved, your doctor retired, you want another doctor, or the online system still shows the wrong doctor.

Prova che vivi nell'area di Torino servita dal medico se l'ufficio la chiede.

en: Try first with the Salute Piemonte doctor-choice service.
Search the doctor and check whether the list is open.

Cerca il medico e controlla se ha ancora posti disponibili.
Se il servizio online blocca il cambio o non mostra posti, usa il percorso ASL o lo sportello di distretto.

body.en: Do not choose only by name. Check district compatibility, whether the doctor still accepts patients, and whether your temporary domicile route has already been recorded.
body.it: Non scegliere solo per nome. Controlla compatibilita di distretto, disponibilita reale del medico e registrazione del tuo eventuale domicilio temporaneo.

body.en: Italian: "Il portale non mi fa scegliere il medico corretto. Vorrei verificare zona, disponibilita e mia posizione sanitaria." English: The portal does not let me choose the correct doctor. I want to verify my area, availability, and health registration.
body.it: Italiano: "Il portale non mi fa scegliere il medico corretto. Vorrei verificare zona, disponibilita e mia posizione sanitaria." Inglese: The portal does not let me choose the correct doctor. I want to verify my area, availability, and health registration.

body.en: Use Premium if the case is blocked, cross-border, document-heavy, or you want a cleaner office strategy.
body.it: Usa Premium se il caso e bloccato, internazionale, ricco di documenti o vuoi una strategia piu chiara per lo sportello.

title.en: SSN versus private insurance: use the right route
title.it: SSN o assicurazione privata: scegli il percorso giusto

shortDescription.en: Use this to understand whether SSN, voluntary SSN, student insurance, travel insurance, or a fuller private policy fits your real problem.
shortDescription.it: Usa questa guida per capire se nel tuo caso servono SSN, SSN volontario, assicurazione studenti, travel insurance o una polizza privata piu completa.

en: Voluntary SSN: best when you want public coverage and your status allows it.
Student private insurance: useful only if your school or permit path accepts it and you understand the exclusions.
Travel medical insurance: often too weak for ordinary life in Torino.
Full private health insurance: broader care, but still not automatically equal to SSN for every administrative purpose.
Family or employer-based SSN: usually stronger than buying private coverage just because you are in a hurry.
it: SSN volontario: migliore quando vuoi copertura pubblica e il tuo status lo consente.
Assicurazione privata studenti: utile solo se scuola o permesso la accettano davvero e se capisci bene le esclusioni.
Travel medical insurance: spesso troppo debole per la vita ordinaria a Torino.
Assicurazione privata completa: copertura piu ampia, ma non equivale automaticamente al SSN per ogni esigenza amministrativa.
SSN tramite famiglia o lavoro: di solito e piu forte che comprare assicurazione privata solo per fretta.

en: Whether the policy is accepted for your university, Questura, employer, or permit case.
Whether GP-like care, specialist visits, medicines, and hospitalization are really included.
Territorial validity in Italy and claim procedure.
Waiting periods, exclusions, deductible, and annual ceiling.
it: Se la polizza e accettata per universita, Questura, datore o pratica di permesso.
Se sono davvero inclusi medico, visite specialistiche, farmaci e ricovero.
Validita territoriale in Italia e procedura di rimborso.
Carenze, esclusioni, franchigia e massimale annuo.

body.en: Price alone is not enough. Emergency-only policies can be useless for ordinary care in Torino, and a cheap policy can fail exactly when you need administrative acceptance.
body.it: Il prezzo da solo non basta. Le polizze solo emergenza possono essere inutili per la vita ordinaria a Torino, e una polizza economica puo fallire proprio quando ti serve l'accettazione amministrativa.

body.en: The questionnaire helps you compare private insurance with SSN logic for Torino. Static guidance is always available. Live top-5 comparison stays premium and only appears when a verified provider source is configured server-side.

Student contract: only if the student conditions are real and documented.

en: Deposito cauzionale: the money held as security, not an extra monthly rent.
Cedolare secca: tax regime chosen by the landlord, not a reason to skip registration.
Spese condominiali: separate building expenses, often partly recoverable from the tenant.
Subentro / cessione: change of people on the contract, not an informal roommate swap.
Transitorio: a contract that needs a real temporary reason.
it: Deposito cauzionale: somma trattenuta come garanzia, non affitto extra mensile.
Cedolare secca: regime fiscale scelto dal proprietario, non motivo per saltare la registrazione.
Spese condominiali: spese del palazzo separate, spesso in parte ribaltate sull'inquilino.
Subentro / cessione: cambio delle persone nel contratto, non semplice scambio informale di coinquilino.
Transitorio: contratto che ha bisogno di una vera ragione temporanea.
